https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for an algorithmic capability, i.e., the rules, from which the cashflows for a credit agreement, financial instrument or related contract, based on their characteristics, can be analyzed

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: algorithmic contract category
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for the cashflows generated by a group of credit agreements, financial instruments, or related contracts, within an ACTUS cashflow family, based on their more specific, common characteristics

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: algorithmic contract family
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for a collection of types of contracts, such as credit agreements, financial instruments, or related kinds of contracts, based on their common characteristics from an ACTUS perspective

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS business day convention
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: code element for one of a set of conventions that ACTUS supports

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS calendar code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: code for a calendar that applies to a particular contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract role classifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for various roles that are relevant to how the contract is processed by a particular contract party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract term
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: code denoting a term describing an aspect of one or more ACTUS contract type(s)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS dictionary term group
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for a collection of ACTUS dictionary parameters that tend to be applied together

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: association
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: not-for-profit organization that is owned by and acts on behalf of its members

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: cooperative society
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: organization owned by and operated for the benefit of those using its services

annotations.example: In agriculture, there are broadly three types of cooperatives: a machinery pool, a manufacturing/marketing cooperative, and a credit union

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: family office
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: organization that assumes the day-to-day administration and management of a family's affairs

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: functional business entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: functional entity defined in terms of the nature of the commercial activity it conducts

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: functional entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party defined in terms of a function they or it performs

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: merchant
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party engaged in the purchase and sales of goods produced by others for profit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: merchant category code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: code used internationally to classify a merchant

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: merchant category code scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheme defining a set of codes for classifying merchant services

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: merchant identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: unique identifier for a merchant that is used, for example, for transaction interchange purposes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: syndicate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: temporary, self-organizing group of people, companies, corporations or entities organized as an alliance whose purpose is to transact some specific business, or to pursue or promote a shared interest

annotations.example: For example, when a group of investment banks work together to bring a new issue of securities to the market, they form a distributing syndicate. Other types of syndicates are created for underwriting, banking, and insurance.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: syndicate member
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: role of an individual or organization that is a member of an alliance set up to pool resources and share risk with respect to a large transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: API-first market data provider
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: market data provider that delivers financial information primarily through programmatic interfaces, offering real-time or historical data via APIs for automated consumption

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: alternative data provider
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: market data provider that supplies non-traditional datasets derived from sources such as web activity, sentiment analysis, geospatial signals, or other alternative information channels

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: crypto and digital-asset data provider
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: market data provider that supplies pricing, reference data, and analytics for digital tokens and crypto-assets

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: derivatives and volatility data provider
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: market data provider that supplies pricing, implied-volatility surfaces, and analytics for derivatives, including options, futures, and structured products

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exchange-sourced data provider
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: market data provider that distributes financial information originating directly from trading venues, including order-book data, trades, quotes, and venue-specific reference data

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fixed income specialist provider
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: market data provider that focuses on pricing, reference data, and analytics for fixed-income instruments such as bonds, credit products, and money-market securities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: institutional market data provider
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: market data provider that supplies multi-asset financial information, analytics, and reference data to financial institutions such as banks, asset managers, and trading firms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market data provider
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: publisher that supplies financial information, reference data, analytics, or related datasets used in financial markets

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: publication
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: document offered for general distribution and usually produced in multiple copies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: publisher
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: role of person(s) or organization(s) responsible for the printing or distribution of an item, whether in digital or print (physical) form

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: reference data specialist provider
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: market data provider that focuses on authoritative reference data, including corporate actions, instrument identifiers, classifications, and entity information aligned with ISO standards

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: branch of government
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: division of the government of a state, with separate and independent powers and areas of responsibility so that the powers of one branch are not in conflict with the powers associated with the other branches

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: devolved government
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: government and the politicians that that run a subnational territory with powers that may be temporary and reversible, ultimately residing with the central government

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: executive branch
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the branch of government that is authorized and responsible for the daily administration of the government

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: federal government
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: union of states under a central government distinct from the individual governments of the separate states

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: federated sovereignty
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: polity characterized by a union of partially self-governing states or regions under a central (federal) government

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: government
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system by which a state or community is controlled

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: government agency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: permanent or semi-permanent organization, often an appointed commission, in the machinery of government that is responsible for the oversight and administration of specific functions

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: government appointee
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: individual designated by government decree to lead, or participate in some capacity in a government body

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: government body
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: formal organization that is an agency, instrumentality, or other body of a supranational, national, federal, state, or local government, including certain multijurisdictional agencies and departments that carry out the business of government

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: government department
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specialized organization responsible for a sector of government public administration

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: government minister
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: government official that is an executive, who is either appointed or elected to a high office in the government

annotations.example: Minister of Finance, Secretary of State, Attorney General of California

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: government official
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person elected or appointed to administer some aspect of a government

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: instrumentality
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: organization that serves a public purpose and is closely tied to a government, but is not a government agency

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: judiciary
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: branch of government that comprises the system of courts that interprets and applies the law in the name of the supranational, national, federal, or regional government, depending on its jurisdiction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legislature
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the law-making body of a political unit, usually a national government, that has power to enact, amend, and repeal public policy

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: polity that typically represents a city, township, or other administrative subdivision having corporate status and powers of self-government or jurisdiction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: municipal government
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: regional government of a city, township, or other administrative subdivision

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: national government
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: government and the politicians that that run a country as a whole (as opposed to local government)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: polity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal person that is a supranational entity, crown, state, or subordinate civil authority, such as a province, prefecture, county, municipality, city, or district representing the people of that entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: regional government
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: administrative body for a geographic area, such as a county, smaller town, or other similar community

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: regional sovereignty
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal person that corresponds to an administrative division, administrative unit, administrative entity or country subdivision (or, sometimes, geopolitical division or subnational entity), that has the capacity to incur debt, issue contracts, and enter into relations with other similar entities

annotations.example: A country may be divided into provinces, which, in turn, are divided into counties, which, in turn, may be divided in whole or in part into municipalities; and so on.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sovereign state
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: non-physical juridical entity that is represented by one centralized government that has sovereignty over a geographic area

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: supranational entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: governmental or non-governmental entity that is established by international law or treaty or incorporated at an international level

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tribal area
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: designation for geographic region administered by a group of indigenous people rather than by a sovereign state or regional governmental entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tribal entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal entity that represents fundamental unit of sovereign tribal (indigenous) government

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tribal government
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: government representing a group of indigenous people that has legal authority to govern those people, including authority to legislate the existence of tribal entities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: identity document
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any legal document which may be used to verify aspects of a person's identity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: national identification number
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: number or text which appears on an identity document issued by a country or jurisdiction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: benefit corporation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: not-for-profit corporation set up under specific state legislation, typically to provide some social benefit, without an obligation to maximize shareholder return

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: board agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: formal, legally binding agreement between members of the Board of Directors of the organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: common interest development corporation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: not-for-profit corporation set up under specific state legislation as a business entity for homeowners' associations

annotations.example: http://www.dre.ca.gov/files/pdf/re39.pdf

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: corporation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: formal organization that is a legal entity (artificial person) distinct from its owners, created under the jurisdiction of the laws of a state or nation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: for profit corporation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporation whose objective is to make money, i.e., to ensure realization of a financial benefit such that the amount of revenue gained from a business activity exceeds the expenses, costs and taxes needed to sustain that activity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: incorporation guarantee
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: guarantee that is part of the financial basis by which some legal entity is incorporated

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: instrument of incorporation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: memorandum and articles of association by which some legal entity is established

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: joint stock company
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: for-profit, unincorporated business that has some characteristics of a corporation and some features of a partnership, with ownership interests represented by shares of stock

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: not-for-profit corporation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporation approved by its jurisdictional oversight and tax authorities as operating for educational, charitable, social, religious, civic or humanitarian purposes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: privately held company
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporation whose issued shares are all held by a family or a small group of investors and, therefore, cannot be bought by the public

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: publicly held company
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporation whose shares are traded and held publicly

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: registration identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier that is officially allocated to an organization at the time of registration, typically in a jurisdiction in which said organization is organized or registered and used in that jurisdiction to identify the organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: registration identifier scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheme that defines the registration identifier per the issuing registration authority

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: religious corporation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: not-for-profit corporation whose objective is specific to some fundamental set of beliefs and practices generally agreed upon by a number of people, and that is incorporated under the law

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: stock corporation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporation that has shareholders, each of whom receives a portion of the ownership of the corporation through shares of stock

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: branch
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: part of a larger organization that might not be co-located with it

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: division
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: part of an organization, such as a line of business, that may have separate accounting and reporting requirements

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: joint venture
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal entity that is formed between parties that pool their resources for the purpose of accomplishing a specific task but otherwise retain their distinct identities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: non-governmental organization
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: not-for-profit organization that functions independently of government

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: not for profit organization
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: organization that uses its surplus revenues to further achieve its purpose rather than distributing its surplus income to the organization's owners (directors, investors, and equivalents) as profit / dividends

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: organization covering agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract between the principals in a formal organization that specifies the relationship between the principals, and between the principals and the entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: value-added tax identification number
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: tax identifier that identifies a taxable person (business) or non-taxable legal entity for a consumption tax that is assessed incrementally, levied on the price of a product or service at each stage of production, distribution, and sale to the end consumer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tax identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier assigned to a taxpayer that enables compulsory financial charges and other levies to be imposed on the taxpayer by a governmental organization in order to fund government spending and various public expenditures

annotations.example: Examples of eligible legal entities include, without limitation: - all financial intermediaries; - banks and finance companies; - all entities that issue equity, debt or other securities for other capital structures; - all entities listed on an exchange; - all entities that trade stock or debt, investment vehicles, including mutual funds, pension funds and alternative investment vehicles constituted as corporate entities or collective investment agreements (including umbrella funds as well as funds under an umbrella structure, hedge funds, private equity funds, etc.); - all entities under the purview of a financial regulator and their affiliates, subsidiaries and holding companies; - counterparties to financial transactions.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: accounting framework
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: framework, including policies, methods, rules, and processes, used to measure, recognize, present, and disclose the information appearing in an entity's financial statements, and, from a legal ownership perspective, that is applied for accounting consolidation determination

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractually capable entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a unique entity that is legally or financially responsible for the performance of financial transactions, or has the legal right in its jurisdiction to enter independently into legal contracts, regardless of whether it is incorporated or constituted in some other way (e.g. trust, partnership, contractual). This excludes natural persons, but includes governmental organizations and supranationals.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity legal form
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a classifier for a legal entity that indicates the nature of that entity as defined from a legal or regulatory perspective, in the jurisdiction in which it was established

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity legal form identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: code that denotes an entity legal form as defined in ISO 20275

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity legal form scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheme that specifies the elements of the codes for entity legal forms, such as those that are sanctioned in a given jurisdiction as defined in ISO 20725

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: LEI registered entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a legal person that has registered for and is identified by a legal entity identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal entity identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an organization identifier that uniquely identifies a legal person as defined in ISO 17442

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal entity identifier scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a scheme that specifies the elements of an unambiguous legal entity identifier (LEI) scheme to identify the legal entities relevant to any financial transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: relationship period qualifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a classifier that qualifies something about the reporting period specified, such as that the date period reflects an accounting or document filing period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: relationship qualifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a classifier that qualifies something about the relationship between consolidated entities during the reporting period, such as the accounting framework used

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: relationship record
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a record describing relationships between legal entities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: relationship status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a classifier that specifies the status of the relationship between consolidated entities during the reporting period (active or inactive)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entity that is formed and administered as per commercial law in order to engage in business activities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business license
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: license that allows the holder to conduct business or carry out a specific profession within some jurisdiction for some period of time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: chartered legal person
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a legal person created by a royal charter or decree

annotations.example: Anything with 'Royal Institute' in the name. Also universities are generally set up by royal charter in a monarchy or principality, (often pre-dating any Privy Council i.e. directly be the monarch in the case of older universities). The Bank of England and the British Broadcasting Council (BBC) are also incorporated through Royal Charter.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legally competent natural person
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person who is considered competent, under the circumstances, to enter into a contract, conduct business, or participate in other activities that generally require the mental ability to understand problems and make decisions on his or her own behalf

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: not for profit objective
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: objective that reflects the charitable, educational, religious, humanitarian, public services, or other not for profit goals of an organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: power of attorney
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal authorization given by one party (the principal) to another (the agent or attorney-in-fact) to perform certain acts on the principal's behalf

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: profit objective
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: objective that reflects pursuit of a financial benefit that may be realized when the amount of revenue gained from a business activity exceeds the expenses, costs and taxes needed to sustain that activity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: public purpose
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: objective that reflects values generally thought to be shared by and that is intended to benefit the populace as a whole

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: religious objective
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: not-for-profit objective that reflects the religious goals of an organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fonds commun de placement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal entity created to fulfill narrow, specific, and frequently temporary objectives

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statutory body
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal entity established by a government to consider evidence and make judgements in some field of activity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: variable interest entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal entity whose shareholders are entitled to a percentage of a named company's profits via a private contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual control
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: control established through the terms of some contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: controlled party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person or organization over which some party exercises some form of authority or influence with respect to some situation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: controlling alliance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: group that has formed some alliance to jointly exercise control over some entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: court appointed control
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: control conferred by the actions of some court, for example in the context of receivership

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: de facto controlling interest party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that exercises some control over an entity other than via explicit, legal means

annotations.example: a silent partner, i.e. where someone has made a large investment, which is bilateral (not part of the constitutional framework of the company)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: de jure controlling interest party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that has the legal authority to exercise control

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity controlling party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that has the authority to control some legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: influence-based de facto control
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: informal control that involves influence over some party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: influence-based de facto controlling party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that holds influence-based control over some other party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investment-based de facto control
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: control that arises through some investment in some entity, other than via the holding of constitutional equity (shares etc.) in that entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investment-based de facto controlling interest party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that holds investment-based control over some other party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: joint controlling party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that collectively has the authority to control the affairs of some business organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: majority controlling party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: controlling party that possesses, either directly or indirectly, the power to direct or cause the direction of the management and policies of a legal person, whether through the ownership of a majority of voting securities, by contract, or otherwise

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: receiver
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party appointed by some court for the purposes of winding up the affairs of some entity which is no longer solvent

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sole controlling party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that has sole control over and directs the affairs of some legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: total owner
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that has 100 percent ownership some legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: affiliate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that is related to a legal entity, directly, or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, and controls, or is controlled by, or is under common control with that entity, typically determined by the degree of ownership

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: affiliation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: situation in which a controlled party is affiliated with a controlling party for some period of time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: controlled affiliate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: controlled party in an affiliation situation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: controlling affiliate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: controlling party in an affiliation situation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: domestic ultimate parent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that is recognized as the ultimate parent of a given organization within the country or jurisdiction of incorporation or organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: global ultimate parent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that is recognized as the ultimate parent of a given organization world-wide

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: joint venture partner
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that shares capital, technology, human resources, risks, and benefits of an entity under shared control

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: significant shareholder
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that owns a significant voting stake in an organization that is less than 50 percent but greater than some threshold

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: subsidiary
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal entity that is entirely or majority owned and controlled by another legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: total controlling interest party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: voting shareholder that owns 100 percent of the voting shares in some legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: voting shareholder
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: shareholder whose shares confer the right to vote in corporate elections, including the right to elect directors at annual or special meetings, and to express their views to corporate management and directors on significant issues that may affect the value of those shares

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: beneficial owner
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that enjoys the benefits of ownership (such as receipt of income) of something even though its ownership (title) may be in the name of another party (called a nominee or registered owner)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: beneficial ownership
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: situation linking party that enjoys the benefits of ownership (such as receipt of income) of something even though its ownership (title) may be in the name of another party (called a nominee or registered owner) to the asset that they own

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: purchase lot
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial asset that is a block of securities or other financial assets bought in one transaction on a given date at a specific price

annotations.example: Buying 100 shares of Apple on Jan 10 at $150/share is one purchase lot; buying 50 more shares on Mar 15 at $160/share is another purchase lot.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: shareholder
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that owns shares in and has rights and responsibilities with respect to some asset, provided in exchange for investment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: shareholding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ownership interest in the equity of a company, represented by shares that confer financial rights and governance privileges

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tax lot
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial asset that is a block of securities or other financial assets with a distinct cost basis for tax reporting purposes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: articles of incorporation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract that establishes a new corporation or, when amended, adjusts the legal basis for the corporation, and outlines basic information about the corporation, including the type of business, and a description of the business' operational characteristics

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: auditor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party qualified and authorized to review and verify the accuracy of financial records and ensure that companies comply with tax laws

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: authorized individual
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: role of an individual that has been given the responsibility to act on behalf of another party under some set of guidelines

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: board capacity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: authority to act in a fiduciary capacity with respect to the organization, including but not limited to determining and executing corporate policy

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: board composition control
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: situation in which a voting shareholder, entity owner, or some other party in the case of a not-for-profit organization, appoints and/or nominates someone to the board of directors of an organization for some period of time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: board member
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that has fiduciary responsibility with respect to the organization, including but not limited to determining and executing corporate policy

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: board membership
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: situation relating an individual member of the board of directors to the organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: board of directors
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: group of people comprising the governing body of an organization that has the authority to set organizational strategy and policies as well as to select and, to some degree manage, leadership

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bylaws
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: written rules for conduct of a corporation, association, partnership or any organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: chief executive officer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: top corporate officer responsible for an organization's overall operations and performance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: chief financial officer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: senior-most corporate officer responsible for financial control and planning for an organization or project

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: company law
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legislation under which the formation, registration or incorporation, governance, and dissolution of a firm is administered and controlled

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: company secretary
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate officer appointed by the directors of an organization, responsible for ensuring compliance with legal obligations related to corporate governance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: controlling nominee
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that holds legal title to an asset (e.g., stocks, bonds, or property) on behalf of the beneficial owner

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: corporate bylaws
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: written rules for conduct of a corporation, adopted by the board of directors

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: corporate officer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: high-level management executive of a corporation or other organization, hired by the board of directors or the business owner(s), charged with certain operational responsibilities, and who has the authority to act on behalf of the organization, including the authority to enter into contracts on behalf of the organization

annotations.example: Corporate officers may include a Chief Executive Officer (CEO), Chief Financial Officer (CFO), president, vice president(s), and in some cases a Chief Operating Officer (COO), Chief Compliance Officer (CCO), or other executive responsible for a critical function in the organization.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: executive
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person appointed and given the responsibility to manage the affairs of an organization and the authority to make decisions within specified role-specific boundaries

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: executive board member
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: member of a board of directors that is also an employee of the organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: external auditor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: independent party qualified and authorized to examine and report on the accuracy of financial records and ensure that companies comply with tax laws

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: internal auditor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: employee who is qualified and authorized to review and verify the accuracy of financial records and evaluate internal controls and compliance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: non-executive board member
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: member of the board of directors of an organization that has no executive responsibilities towards the running of that organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: principal party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: controlling party that is responsible for the management of daily business operations of an organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: signatory
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: responsible party authorized to sign agreements on behalf of themselves, another person, or an organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: constitutional owner
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entity owner that holds an equity stake in said entity, in the form of shareholders' equity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: controlling equity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: shareholders's equity that formally confers control in the entity, either by law or as explicitly stated in a corresponding equity instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: direct consolidation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: direct ownership of an entity recorded as accounting consolidation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity owner
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: owner (person, group of people, or other business entity) that owns, or holds an ownership interest in, a formal business organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity ownership
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ownership by some party of an interest in some non-governmental formal organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: foreign branch ownership
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ownership by some party of some formal organization or organizational sub-unit that is a foreign affiliate and legally part of the owning entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investment equity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: equity that represents an ownership interest in some entity, but may or may not take the form of shareholders's equity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that owns some stake in some organization by way of investment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investor contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Contract setting out the terms under which some investor invests in the entity and setting out the rights which are conferred on that investor.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ultimate ownership
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: highest-level (top, end) ancestral ownership, evidenced by accounting consolidation, by some party of some other legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: general partner
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: partner and part-owner that is responsible for managing the day to day operations of the partnership and that may be jointly and severally liable for the obligations of the partnership

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: general partnership
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: partnership that has at least two general partners that agree to share in all assets, profits, and financial and legal liabilities of the business

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: limited liability limited partnership
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: limited partnership that consists of one or more general partners who are liable for the obligations of the entity as well as one or more protected limited liability partners

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: limited liability partnership
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: partnership that has general partners but provides its individual partners some level of protection against personal liability for certain partnership liabilities

annotations.example: Law firms, accountancies, wealth managers, professional medical groups, and other professional consultancies often take the form of a limited liability partnership.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: limited partner
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: partner whose liabilities are limited to the extent of their investment or guarantees and that has no involvement in the day to day operations of the partnership

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: limited partnership
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: partnership that has at least one general partner and at least one limited partner

annotations.example: In the United States, film production companies, real estate investment firms, and private equity firms are typically formed as limited partnerships. In the United Kingdom, limited partnerships are governed by the Limited Partnerships Act 1907 and, on matters on which that Act is silent, also by the Partnership Act 1890.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: partner
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: co-owner, member, and agent of a partnership whose participation level, including proportional liabilities and share in the profit / loss of the business is specified in a partnership agreement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: partnership
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: association of two or more legal persons to carry on as co-owners a business for profit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: partnership agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract between partners in a partnership that establishes the terms and conditions of the relationship between the partners

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: limited liability company
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: private limited company that combines the pass through taxation of a sole proprietorship or partnership with the limited liability of a corporation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: limited liability company member
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: owner of an interest in a limited liability company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: limited liability company taxed as a corporation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: limited liability company that has elected to have corporate tax status

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: manager-managed limited liability company
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: limited liability company in which the members appoint one or more managers to handle the daily operations and administrative responsibilities of the organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: managing member
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: owner of an interest in a limited liability company who also runs the day-to-day business operations

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private company with limited liability
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: hybrid business entity having characteristics of both a corporation and a partnership or sole proprietorship (depending on how many owners there are)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private limited company
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: private limited company whose shareholders' liability is limited to the capital they originally invested

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sole proprietor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that owns a business, has the rights to all profits from that business and is considered a single entity (unincorporated) together with that business for tax and liability purposes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sole proprietorship
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: unincorporated business owned by a single person

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: irrevocable trust
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: trust that cannot be modified, amended or terminated except under certain legal circumstances and typically not without the permission of the grantor's named beneficiary or beneficiaries

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: living trust
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: trust created during an individual's lifetime where a designated person, the trustee, is given responsibility for managing that individual's assets for the benefit of the eventual beneficiary

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: revocable trust
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: trust in which legal ownership of the trust property is transferred to the trustee, but the trustor retains full power to revoke, modify or amend the trust

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: testamentary trust
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: trust established in accordance with the instructions contained in a last will and testament

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trust
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: fiduciary relationship and legal entity in which one party, known as a trustor, gives another party, the trustee, the right to hold title to and manage assets for the benefit of a third party, the beneficiary

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trust agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: formal agreement that establishes a trust, whereby the trustor(s) gives the trustee(s) the responsibility to hold and manage assets for the beneficiary(ies)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trust beneficiary
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party for whose interest (benefit) an annuity, assignment (such as a letter of credit), contract, insurance policy, judgment, promise, trust, will, etc., is made

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trust fund manager
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party empowered to act on behalf of the trustee to manage the assets of the trust

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trustee
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that holds and manages assets for the benefit of another

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trustor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that establishes a trust and places property under the protection and management of one or more trustees for the benefit of at least one beneficiary

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: clearing
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The process by which securities trades are cleared.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: clearing and settlement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The business process or service area of securities clearing and settlement.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial industry context
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The context in which business activites take place within the financial industry, i.e. investment management, wholesale financial markets trading and so on.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: primary market
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Issuance and primary market trading of new Traded Financial Instruments

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: securities trades matching
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Matching of trade allegations to identify confirmed trades, on an Over the Counter market in Traded Securities.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: draft pass through termsheet
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Draft of set of information defining the pass thorugh security terms. These will eventually become the contractual terms of the instrument. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: identify conforming mortgage
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Identify mortgage conforming to overall requirements for this issuer.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: not yet issued agency mortgage pool
pass through issue prospectus part
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A part or section of a prospectus for a pass through MBS issue. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pass through m b s draft prospectus
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The draft prospectus for a pass through Mortgage Backed Securities issue, as determined by the issuing agency prior to marketing the issue. Certain terms in the draft prospectus will be finalized later in the issuance process to become the actual Prospectus. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pass through m b s final prospectus
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pass through m b s final termsheet
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The final termsheet for the pass through MBS issue. This defines the terms for the MBS contract itself. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pass through m b s securitization process
pass through offering memorandum
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The offering memorandum for a pass through MBS issue, setting out basic information about a future issue, for the information of prospective investors and their agents. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: potential agency m b s issuer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The entity which will become the issuing party for the pass through MBS Issue. This entity is the principal actor in most of the activities involved in the issue. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: potential pass through issuance underwriter
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The entity which will become the underwriter for the pass through MBS issue. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: validate conformance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The mortgage is automatically validated for conformance to the requirements of the pool in which it is to be included.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: advance refunding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: refunding in which bond issuance in which new bonds are sold at a lower rate than outstanding ones

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond issuance programme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a debt issuance programe under which an entity may, from time to time, issue bonds under the terms and conditions specified in the base prospectus for that programme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond offering
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a debt offering of one or more bonds, as all or part of an issuance programme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond offering with warrant
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a bond offering where the issue includes a warrant; Further notes: ISO 10962 CFI definition is A bond that is issued together with one or more warrant(s) attached as part of the offer, the warrant(s) granting the holder the right to purchase a designated security, often the common stock of the issuer of the debt, at a specified price. Review notes: This need not be any specific type of bond. The warrant is used as a sweetener to encourage people to subscribe to a new bond issue. The Bond and the Warrant trade together as a unit (called "Bond Unit").

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: debt issuance process information
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: information specific to the issuance of a debt security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: debt issuance programme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a series of debt security issuances over time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: debt issuance purpose
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: purpose for the issuance of a debt security; also defines processes to be followed in some instances

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: home equity line of credit pool creation process
issuance process activity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An activity within the process of securities issuance.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: medium term note issuance programme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a program of offerings of medium term notes; a set of issues where the maturity is defined after the rest of the terms have been registered with some authority; these are registered up front so that then the company wants to borrow more money they don't have to go through the registration period but have the facility up front to issue another security.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: muni issue underwriter
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The party which agrees to buy any certificates that are not bought by investors Term origin:DTCC

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: new money purpose
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: securities issued to raise funds for a new project or purpose

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pool backed security securitization process actor
refunding purpose
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a procedure whereby an issuer refinances outstanding bonds by issuing new bonds

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: remarketing purpose
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the process of reselling securities to the public that have been tendered for purchase by the previous owners thereof

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: retail asset pool creation process
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The process by which pools of assets are created. These may then be used in the issue of securities based on those asset pools as underlying.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underwriter takedown for debt
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: information on takedown quantity of the debt security handled by the underwriter (that will be brought into DTC)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: debt offering

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underwriter takedown
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Infomation on Takedown quantity of the security handled by the underwriter (that will be brought into DTC).

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underwriting process details
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Information specific to the Underwriting of the Issue.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: muni debt offering
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The process step of offering a Municipal Debt security for issue.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: securities underwriting issuance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Underwriting, as a method of Securities Issuance.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: securities underwriting issuance process
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The process by which debt instruments are offered to the market by a syndicate of underwriters who underwrite the issue.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any actor within the DTCC Underwriting Process or any other Underwriting Process. https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: broker dealer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An entity which may become a primary investor in the issue. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Draft of set of information defining one tranche of a tranched issue. This will become the termsheet of an individual tranche within that issue. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

numbering agency

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: potential non agency m b s issuer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The entity which will become the issuing party for the Tranched MBS Issue. This entity is the principal actor in most of the activities involved in the issue. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: potential tranched issue underwriter
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The entity which will become the underwriter for the tranched MBS issue. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: primary investor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A party which becomes the primary investor in the issue, by purchasing some of the tranches of the issue. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: register security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: After the deal is closed the security is formally registered with some registraton authority This is the "official" bit - there is not a separate "Issue" activity which is official ?????

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: remittance report
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Report containing a specific and limited set of information about the Deal. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tranche structure and termsheet

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tranched m b s issue prospectus part
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A part or section of a prospectus for a tranched mortgage backed securities issue. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tranched m b s primary deal transaction settlement process
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The process by which the primary deal transaction is settled. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: event announced, initiated or carried out by an organization that affects a legal entity or the securities it issues and may have a material impact on that entity's stakeholders, such as shareholders and creditors

annotations.example: Actions that impact an entity may be initiated by an issuer, exchange, regulator, creditor, or other third party.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: action classification scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheme for classifying the kinds of actions and events that may be announced, initiated or carried out by an organization that affects a legal entity or the securities it issues

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: action classifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier that distinguishes the kinds of actions and events that may be announced, initiated or carried out by an organization that affects a legal entity or the securities it issues, such as income-oriented events

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: action status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: state of some action at some point in time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business strategy classifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier of corporate actions that involve improving liquidity or changing the overall structure of the organization through diversification, combining and closing parts of the business, etc, to increase long-term profitability

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: change action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action to disseminate information regarding a change further described in the corporate action details

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: class action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action involving a situation where interested parties seek restitution for financial loss

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: consent solicitation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action that is a procedure that aims to obtain consent of holder to a proposal by the issuer or a third party without convening a meeting

annotations.example: For example, consent to change the terms of a bond.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: corporate action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: action carried out by or specifically relating to a legal entity that may affect the securities it issues and may have a material impact on its stakeholders, such as shareholders and creditors

annotations.example: Examples of corporate actions include share issues, stock splits, consolidation, dividends, mergers and acquisitions, rights issues, spin-offs, and the inception of court actions.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: disclosure action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action involving a request for holders or beneficial owners to disclose their name, location and holdings of any issue to the issuer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: divestiture
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action involving the sales of subsidiary business interests or investments

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: income-oriented classifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier of corporate actions that impacts income to shareholders

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal form change
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action indicating a modification of the legal form of the organization

annotations.example: In the United States it is common for companies established as Subchapter S Corporations (S-Corp), typically early stage companies, to modify their structure to become full-fledged Subchapter C Corporations (C-Corp) to facilitate outside fundraising, mergers, acquisitions, and public offerings. Other common form changes include migration from sole proprietorships to more formally registered organizations (e.g., LLC, S-Corp, C-Corp, etc.)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: liquidation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action related to winding up a business, including but not limited to distribution of cash, assets, or both

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mandatory corporate action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: action initiated by the board of directors of a corporation that affects all shareholders

annotations.example: Examples of mandatory corporate actions include cash dividends, stock splits, mergers, pre-refunding, return of capital, bonus issue, asset ID change, and spin-offs.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mandatory with choice corporate action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: mandatory corporate action where shareholders are given an opportunity to choose among several options

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: action that is initiated by a market, such as a securities exchange, that affects a legal entity or the securities it issues and may have a material impact on that entity's stakeholders, such as shareholders and creditors

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: merger / acquisition
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action involving the consolidation of legal entities or assets

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: notification
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action involving information provided by the issuer having no accounting/financial impact on the holder

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: organization address change
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: information action that provides details of address changes for a legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: organization name change
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: information action that provides details of name changes for a legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: priority issue
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action that is a public offer where, due to a limited amount of securities available, priority is given to existing shareholders

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: regulatory action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: action initiated by a regulatory agency that affects a legal entity or the securities it issues and may have a material impact on that entity's stakeholders, such as shareholders and creditors

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: spin off
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action involving the distribution of subsidiary stock to the shareholders of the parent company without a surrender of shares

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: voluntary corporate action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: event in which the shareholders elect to participate and must respond in order for the issuer to process the action

annotations.example: An example of a voluntary corporate action is a tender offer, in which the issuer may request shareholders to tender their shares at a predetermined price.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: action group
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier that differentiates corporate actions based on a GLEIF specific grouping

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bond default event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action which indicates a failure by the issuer to perform obligations defined as default events under the bond agreement and that have not been remedied

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bonus issue
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action in which security holders are awarded additional assets free of payment from the issuer in proportion to their holding

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bonus rights issue
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A Rights Issue in which the rights are given to the holders of the referenced shares for free.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: call on intermediate securities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action that involves a call or exercise on nil paid securities or intermediate securities resulting from an intermediate securities distribution (RHDI)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: cancellation of shares
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The cancellation of shares. Further Notes Only possible with shares not publicly issued i.e. treasury shares

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: capital distribution
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action that pays shareholders an amount in cash issued from the issuer's capital account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: capital gains distribution
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action that distributes profits resulting from the sale of company assets to shareholders

annotations.example: Shareholders of Mutual Funds, Unit Trusts, or SICAVs are recipients of capital gains distributions which are often reinvested in additional shares of the fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: cash dividend action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action that distributes cash to shareholders in proportion to their equity holding

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: change of security trading status event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An event in which the trading status of a tradable security changes.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: change to smallest negotiable unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Modification of the smallest negotiable unit of shares in order to obtain a new negotiable unit. SWIFT:SMAL

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: conversion action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action involving conversion of securities (generally convertible bonds or preferred shares) into another form of securities (usually common shares) at a pre-stated price/ratio

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: conversion suspension action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Suspension of conversion of securities, generally a couple of weeks before a meeting takes place. SWIFT = SCOP

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: corporate action obligation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An obligation related to the holding of a Security.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: corporate action securities delivery obligation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Some obligation to deliver some security in the thr context of corporate actions. All cash proceeds and security proceeds can be represented a s acontractual obligation. Where does that obligation arise? Usually in the Contract itself - but there may be other answers to this. Defines what has to be delivered. or paid. Entitlement meanwhile is a calculation based on the Contract.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: corporate change of status event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Some change to the status of some security.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: coupon strip
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Coupon stripping is the process whereby interest coupons for future payment dates are separated from the security corpus that entitles the holder to the principal repayment.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: decrease in value action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action resulting in a reduction of face value of a share or the value of fund assets

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: dividend option action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action that involves distribution of a dividend to shareholders with a choice of benefit to receive

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: dividend reinvestment action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action that involves a dividend payment whereby holders can keep cash or have the cash reinvested into additional shares in the issuing company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: drawing
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Redemption in part before the scheduled final maturity date of a security.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: dutch auction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action by a party wishing to acquire a security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exchange action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action that reflects an exchange of holdings for other securities and/or cash

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: formal offer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action involving an offer to a holder, potential holder, or other intersted party, to enter into a trade which is or would be legally binding on the part of the party making the offer (the offeror).

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: full call early redemption action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action that involves redemption of an entire issue outstanding of securities prior to maturity

annotations.example: Examples securities that may be subject to a full call/early redemption include bonds, preferred equity, funds, that may be redeemed by the issuer or its agent before final maturity.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interest payment action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: corporate action that involves distribution of a regular interest payment to holders of an interest-bearing asset

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interest payment in kind
