https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: structure name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: name for a building, house, office complex, shopping center, or other structure or group of structures

annotations.example: Examples include 'McCoy Center', which is the name of the office complex where JPMorgan Chase's Polaris facility is located, 'Apple Park', which is the name of the corporate headquarters of Apple, Inc., and 'Howells Bridge Cottage', which is the name of a very old cottage in Cornwall.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: supplemental address component
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: address component that provides additional information that is important to ensuring proper delivery of communications

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: supplemental address designator
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for supplemental address information, such as a highway contract route, rural route, building complex, shopping center, condominium complex, mail box, or other similar designation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: supplemental address unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: address component that includes a specific route, box, apartment, condominium or other indicator or unit associated with a specific address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: virtual address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: address identifying a virtual, i.e. non-physical, location

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: complete address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address that has all the address elements necessary to allow an exact match with the current Postal Service ZIP+4 and City State files to obtain the finest level of ZIP+4 and delivery point codes for the delivery address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: delivery address code set
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system of numeric codes that substitute for specified delivery point details according to the U.S. Postal Service Publication 28

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: delivery point code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specific set of digits between 00 and 99 assigned to a delivery point

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: delivery point code set
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system of numeric codes that substitute for specified delivery point details according to the U.S. Postal Service Publication 28

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Department of State address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses 'UNIT' followed by the unit identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address, 'DPO' as the literal value for the city, and the appropriate armed forces subdivision code in place of a subdivision (state) code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Department of State unit component
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: component of a Department of State address that includes 'UNIT' followed by the unit identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: general delivery address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address that uses the words 'GENERAL DELIVERY', uppercase preferred, spelled out (no abbreviation), in place of a street address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: highway contract route
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: highway contract route associated with an address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: highway contract address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses the abbreviation 'HC', followed by the route identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: international address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: physical address that explicitly includes a country

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mailbox
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: mailbox, other than a U.S. Post Office box, associated with an address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: overseas military address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses an abbreviation for the unit or command such as 'CMR', 'PSC', or 'UNIT', or 'HC', followed by the unit identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address, either 'APO' or 'FPO' as the literal value for the city and the appropriate armed forces subdivision code in place of a subdivision (state) code

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private mail box address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address provided by a commercial mail receiving company that includes a supplementary address line containing the abbreviation 'PMB' or the pound "#" symbol followed by the mailbox number; alternatively, 'PMB' or '#" and the mailbox number can be appended to the street address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Puerto Rico address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address for a delivery point in Puerto Rico that may include a supplementary address line containing the abbreviation 'URB' followed by the name of the urbanization area that is appropriate for that address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: highway contract route address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: mail route outside the city or township limits in a rural area associated with an address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rural route address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address whose delivery address line uses the abbreviation 'RR', followed by the route identifier, followed by 'BOX' followed by box number, in place of a street address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: standardized address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery address that is fully spelled out, abbreviated by using the Postal Service standard abbreviations or as given in the current Postal Service ZIP+4 file

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: U.S. Postal Service address identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: combined with the ZIP + 4 code, the delivery point code provides a unique identifier for every deliverable address served by the USPS

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: urbanization
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an area, sector, or development within a larger geographic area

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Zip Code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: five-digit code code assigned to a delivery address indicating the state and post office or postal zone

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ZIP+4 Code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: nine-digit number consisting of five digits, a hyphen, and four digits, which the USPS describes by its trademark ZIP+4

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: zip code scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system used in the U.S. to facilitate the delivery of mail, consisting of a five- or nine-digit code Zone Improvement Plan (ZIP) printed directly after the address, the first five digits (initial code) indicating the state and post office or postal zone, the last four (expanded code) the box section or number, portion of a rural route, building, or other specific delivery location

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: personal property
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: asset that is a movable item or possession not fixed to land

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: property inspection
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: event that involves analyzing one or more aspects of a real property

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: property inspection report
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: report covering the findings of a property inspection

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: real estate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: real property, interests in mortgages on real property (including interests in mortgages on leaseholds of land or improvements thereon), and shares in qualified real estate investment trusts

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: real property
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: physical asset defined as land together with any structures that are permanently attached to that land, such as houses, trees, fences and improvements

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: real property appraisal
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: value assessment that estimates the amount of money some real property is worth

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: real property identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: unique identifier given to identify a specific real property in some jurisidiction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: electronic mail address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: virtual address that defines an electronic messaging endpoint to which email messages can be delivered, typically via an Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) based communications system

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: network location
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a virtual location that may be identified by a network address (an identifier for a node or interface)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: notional place
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an abstract place; one of many commonly understood concepts such as domestic, Eurozone etc.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: telephone number
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: virtual address that may be assigned to a fixed-line telephone subscriber station connected to a telephone line or to a wireless electronic telephony device, such as a radio telephone or a mobile telephone, or to other devices or services for data transmission via the public switched telephone network (PSTN) or other public and private networks

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payee
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a party to whom a debt should be paid, or to whose order a bill of exchange, note, or check is made payable, or who receives or will receive a payment from a payer in partial or complete fulfillment of an obligation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a party who pays a bill or fees, or who makes payments to a payee in partial or complete fulfillment of an obligation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: delivery of money in fulfillment of an obligation, such as to satisfy a claim or debt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payment event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an event that involves delivery of money in fulfillment of an obligation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payment obligation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legally enforceable duty to pay a sum of money according to the terms stated in a contract

annotations.example: the duty of a borrower to repay a loan, related to the legal right of a lender to enforce payment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payment schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: schedule for delivery of money in fulfillment of an obligation

annotations.example: Examples include coupon payment, loan payment, and interest payment schedules, among others.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: buyer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that purchases something in exchange for money or other consideration under a contract of sale

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: client
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that purchases professional services from, or has a formal relationship to purchase services from another party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: client identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters uniquely identifying a client within the context of some organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: commodity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: material resource used in commerce that is interchangeable with other commodities of the same type

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: consumer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that utilizes economic goods or services, typically for personal, family, or household purposes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual template product
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contractual product that is finalized through specification of values for parameters defined in a template

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: custom product
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: product that is made to order, commissioned based on a customer's specifications

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: customer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that receives or consumes products (goods or services) and has the ability to choose between different products and suppliers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: customer identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters uniquely identifying a customer within the context of some organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: good
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: physical, produced item over which ownership rights can be established, whose ownership can be passed from one party to another by engaging in transactions, and that is not money or real estate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: negotiable commodity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: commodity that can be bought or sold in some marketplace

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: off-the-shelf product
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: product that is readily available from merchandise in stock, or can be quickly and easily configured to order, not specially designed or custom-made

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: producer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: grower, maker, fabricator, or manufacturer of some product or other good

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: product identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sequence of characters uniquely identifying a product in some context

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sale
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exchange of goods or services for money

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: seller
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that makes, offers or contracts to make a sale to an actual or potential buyer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: service agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: written contract between a client and service provider whereby the service provider supplies some service in the form of time, effort, and/or expertise in exchange for compensation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: supplier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that provides goods or services that some party wants or needs, especially over a long period of time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction confirmation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: written communication from a seller or service provider reciting the relevant details of a transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any sale, assignment, lease, license, loan, advance, contribution, or other transfer of any interest in or right to use any property (tangible or intangible) or money, however that transaction is effected, and regardless of whether the terms of the transaction are formally documented

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: referent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: something that another concept stands for, exemplifies, symbolizes, or otherwise mentions

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Any transaction which defines a supply of some negotiable item in return for some Consideration. The Market Transaction has a Principal and a Counterparty, i.e. it is not symmetrical.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual economic agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An economic agreement forming part of a transaction, which has contractual standing as evidenced by a contract between the two parties to the Agreement.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An economic transaction which has some contractual basis.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual transaction party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: That which is party to a transaction which has contractual standing.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: covered transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A transaction covered by some Master Agreement.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: economic commitment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Some Commitment which forms part of the subject of some Transaction, being an undertaking by one or other of the parties to the transaction, extended to the other party to that same transaction.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: economic contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A contract relating to and governing an economic transaction between two parties.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: economic contract commitment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Terms underlying the contract for a transaction.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: economic resource
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Anything that can bought sold or exchanged.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: economic transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Some exchange of some items of economic value between two parties (economic agents).

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: r e a claim
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Some imbalance, at a given point in time, between the respective rights and obligations of two parties with respect to one another.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction business event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Occurrence in time that partners to a business transaction wish to monitor or control.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The event component of a transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction event aspect
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A transaction side as seen from the perspective of one of the parties to the transaction.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Some entity which takes part in some transaction by receiving and/or parting with some item of economic value or some payment or both.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transaction undertaking
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A contractually defined and established commitment to deliver some goods, perform some service or make some payment in cash or in kind.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: undertaking
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Some undertaking to act.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: undertaking event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Something which occurs at a point in time, at which a party makes some commitment to some other party.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial securities secondary market transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A Transaction in which some negotiable security is provided in exchange for some Consideration.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: securities transaction contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The contract (written or implied) which governs the transaction of securities in the secondary Market.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: when issued transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Trading in securities ahead of them being traded.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: annualized standard deviation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: standard deviation for some measure over a specific reference period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: arithmetic mean
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sum of a collection of numbers divided by the number of numbers in the collection

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: average absolute deviation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: average of the absolute deviations from a central point

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: difference
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: quantity by which amounts differ; the remainder left after subtraction of one value from another

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: dispersion
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: degree of scatter or variability shown by observations

annotations.example: Common examples of measures of statistical dispersion are the variance, standard deviation, and interquartile range. The collection size argument, above, represents the number of elements in the set, if known. The collection of values under consideration is represented as a structured collection in FIBO, typically a sample set derived from a finite population.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: finite population
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: population for which it is possible to count its units

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: formula
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rule expressed in letters and symbols that consists of at least one expression

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: geometric mean
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: mean that indicates the central tendency or typical value of a set of numbers by using the product of their values (as opposed to the arithmetic mean which uses their sum)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: key performance indicator
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measurable target that indicates how an individual or business is performing in terms of meeting its goals

annotations.example: Examples include profits, sales numbers, employee turnover and average annual expenses.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mean
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: most common measure of central tendency; the average of a set of numbers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: median
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: value of the variate dividing the total frequency of a data sample, population, or probability distribution, into two halves

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: median absolute deviation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: median of the absolute deviations of observations from the average which may be the arithmetic mean, the median or the mode

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: numeric index value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: numeric value of some aggregate relative to the value of that aggregate as of some date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: qualified measure
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical measure that is constrained by features, quantity kinds or units that refine how it is calculated

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sampling variance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of the extent to which the estimate of a characteristic from different possible samples of the same size and the same design differ from one another

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: scoped measure
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: qualified measure that is constrained by filters on the statistical population to which it applies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: standard deviation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: square root of variance that measures the spread or dispersion around the mean of a data set

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statistical area
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: physical location that is defined per some program for designating geographic regions for the purposes of tabulating and presenting statistical data

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statistical area identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier for a physical location that is defined per a nationally consistent program for designating geographic regions for the purposes of tabulating and presenting statistical data

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statistical measure
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: summary (means, mode, total, index, etc.) of the individual quantitative variable values for the statistical units in a specific group (study domain)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statistical population
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical universe filtered by time and region

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statistical program
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: program that presents a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation involving one or more studies or surveys

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statistical universe
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: collection representing the total membership, or 'universe', of people, resources, products, services, events, or entities of interest for some question, experiment, survey or statistical program

annotations.example: A statistical universe can be a group of actually existing objects (e.g. the set of all stars within the Milky Way galaxy) or a hypothetical and potentially infinite group of objects conceived as a generalization from experience (e.g. the set of all possible hands in a game of poker).

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: variance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of spread, calculated as the average squared deviation of each number from the mean of a data set

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: weighting function
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: expression or function that determines the relative importance or influence of a given element of a set with respect to the whole

annotations.example: Given a sample size of 1000, and a population of 300M, then the chance that any individual is selected is 1 in 300K. In that case, 300K is the weight assigned to each of the elements in the sample.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: module
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier used to indicate a category used to modularize something based on principles of the model driven architecture methodology (MDA), including but not limited to separation of concerns, coherence, and establishing clear logical boundaries in order to increase reusability and maintainability

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: average daily earnings
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of the average daily wage an employee makes over the reporting period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: average earnings
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of the average wage an hourly or salaried worker makes in a given period of time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: average hourly earnings
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of the average hourly wage an employee makes over the reporting period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: average monthly earnings
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of the average monthly wage an employee makes over the reporting period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: average weekly earnings
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of the average weekly wage an employee makes over the reporting period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: capital-labor-energy-materials multifactor productivity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio of a quantity index of gross output to a quantity index of combined inputs

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: capital-labor multifactor productivity (MFP), based on value added
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio of a quantity index of value added to a quantity index of combined labor and capital input

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: capital productivity, based on value added
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio of a quantity index of value added to a quantity index of capital input

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: civilian
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person that is not a member of the military (i.e., that is not on active duty)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: civilian labor force
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the civilian, non-institutional population considered to be part of the labor force during a given reporting period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: civilian labor force participation rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing the rate of participation the labor force of a given economy for some specified period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: civilian non-institutional person
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal working-age person that does not live in an institution (for example, a correctional facility, long-term care hospital, or nursing home), and is not on active military duty

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: civilian non-institutional population
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical universe consisting of people of a certain age who reside in a given region, do not live in institutions (for example, correctional facilities, long-term care hospitals, and nursing homes), and are not on active military duty

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: combined statistical area
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: combination of adjacent metropolitan and micropolitan areas with economic ties measured by commuting patterns

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: consumer price index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing measure of the change over time in the prices of consumer goods and services that households consume

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: discouraged worker population
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the marginally attached population that have given a job-market related reason for not currently looking for work

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: economic indicator
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical measure of economic activity that is regular and comparable in the context of a statistical area (region), used for analysis of economic performance and predictions of future performance

annotations.example: Example indicators include the average work week, weekly claims for unemployment insurance, new orders, vendor performance, stock prices, and changes in the money supply.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employed population
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the civilian labor force considered to be employed during the reporting period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employed population part-time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the employed population that includes persons that are working fewer than 30 to 35 hours per week based on usual working hours

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employed population part-time for economic reasons
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the employed population that includes persons that are working fewer than 30 to 35 hours per week due to slack work, unfavorable business conditions, inability to find full-time work, and seasonal declines in demand

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employed population part-time for non-economic reasons
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the employed population that includes persons that are working fewer than 30 to 35 hours per week due to illness or other health or medical limitations, childcare problems, family or personal obligations, being in school or training, retirement or Social Security limits on earnings, and having a job where full-time work is less than 35 hours

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employed population temporarily not at work
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the employed population that includes persons that are temporarily absent from work for various reasons

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employment-population ratio
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing the ratio of the employed population with respect to the overall civilian non-institutional population of a given economy for some specified period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: enterprise
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: functional business entity that produces and/or sells goods or services

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: enterprise population
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical universe consisting of enterprises designed for the purposes of supporting surveys such as those used as the basis for employment and producer price indices

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: establishment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an enterprise (or part of an enterprise) that operates from a single physical location

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: establishment employment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing the total number of persons who work in or for the establishment including working proprietors, active business partners and unpaid family workers, as well as persons working outside the establishment when paid by and under the control of the establishment, for example, sales representatives, outside service engineers and repair and maintenance personnel

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: establishment population
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a subset of the enterprise population focused on establishments

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fixed basket
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basket of goods and services whose quantity and quality are held fixed for some period of time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fixed basket constituent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: component of a fixed basket

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fixed basket population
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical universe consisting of specific goods and/or services designed for the purposes of supporting surveys such as those used as the basis for price indices

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: government-specified statistical area
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical area defined by a government agency

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: gross domestic product
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing the broadest measure of aggregate economic activity, measuring the total unduplicated market value of all final goods and services produced within a statistical area in a period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: household
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: individual or small group of persons who occupy a housing unit (such as a house or apartment) as their usual place of residence, who pool some, or all, of their income and wealth and who consume certain types of goods and services collectively, mainly housing and food

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: housing unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: house, an apartment, a mobile home or trailer, a group of rooms, or a single room occupied as separate living quarters, or if vacant, intended for occupancy as separate living quarters

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: inflation rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing a change in prices of goods and services for a specified period, for a given statistical area

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: input producer price index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing measure of the rate of change over time in the prices of inputs of goods and services purchased by the producer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: institutional person
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person that resides in an institution for some reason, due, for example, to hospitalization, rehabilitation, or incarceration

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: institutional unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that is capable, in its own right, of owning assets, incurring liabilities, and engaging in economic activities and in transactions with other parties

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: labor productivity, based on gross output
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio of a quantity index of gross output to a quantity index of labor input

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: labor productivity, based on value added
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio of a quantity index of value added to a quantity index of labor input

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: marginally attached population
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the population that includes people who currently are neither working nor looking for work but indicate that they want and are available for a job and have looked for work sometime in the past 12 months

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: metropolitan statistical area
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: one or more adjacent counties or county equivalents that have at least one urban core area of at least 50,000 population, plus adjacent territory that has a high degree of social and economic integration with the core as measured by commuting ties

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: micropolitan statistical area
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: one or more adjacent counties or county equivalents that have at least one urban core area of at least 10,000 population but less than 50,000, plus adjacent territory that has a high degree of social and economic integration with the core as measured by commuting ties

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: military person
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person that is a member of the active duty military

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: output producer price index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing measure of the rate of change over time in the prices of products sold as they leave the producer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: personal consumption expenditures
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing measure of the value of the goods and services purchased by, or on the behalf of, 'persons'

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: population not in the labor force
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the civilian, noninstitutional population, that is considered neither employed nor unemployed by the reporting agency during the reporting period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: producer price index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing measure of the rate of change over time in the prices of goods and services bought and sold by producers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: productivity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing ratio of a volume measure of output to a volume measure of input use

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: statistical information publisher
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: publisher that packages and makes analytical and statistical data available

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ultimate consumer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: person that is the ultimate user of a good, product or service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underemployed population
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the employed population that includes persons employed part-time for economic reasons, who want and are available for full-time work but have had to settle for a part-time schedule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underemployed population with respect to occupation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the underemployed population that includes persons employed in a role that does not reflect their training and experience, excluding those that change careers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underutilized population
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the civilian non-institutional population that includes persons employed part-time for economic reasons, persons that are marginally attached to the labor force, and persons that are identified as unemployed

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unemployed population
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: subset of the civilian labor force that is considered to have had no employment but was available for work, except for temporary illness, and had made specific efforts to find employment sometime during a specified period, during the reporting period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unemployment rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing the ratio of the unemployed population with respect to the civilian labor force of a given economy for some specified period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: value-added producer price index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing a weighted average of the input and output producer price indices

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Canadian consumer price index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: economic indicator representing a measure of changes over time in the prices of a fixed basket of consumer goods and services that Canadian private households consume

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Canadian households consumers universe
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a statistical universe consisting of all private households in Canada, with the exception of soldiers on military bases, people living on First Nations reserves, institutionalized persons, and households living in the rural areas of the three northern territories

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Canadian producer price index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an economic indicator representing a measure of the change over time in the prices of a fixed-basket of domestic producer goods and services

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: industrial products sector
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a classifier for a sector of the economy used for price indices focused on major commodities sold by manufacturers in Canada

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: new housing sector
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a classifier for a sector of the economy used for price indices focused on contractors' selling prices of new residential houses, where detailed specifications pertaining to each house remain the same between two consecutive periods

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: raw materials sector
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a classifier used for price indices related to raw materials purchased by industries in Canada for further processing

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: American statistics publisher
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical information publisher comprised of the government agencies and departments that publish statistical information on behalf of the U.S. Federal Government

annotations.example: Examples of American statistical information publishers include the Department of Commerce, Bureau of Economic Analysis (Commerce), Census Bureau (Commerce), Bureau of Labor Statistics (Labor), Department of the Treasury, and the Federal Reserve Board, among others.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: consumer expenditure survey
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical program conducted on a regular basis that provides information on the buying habits of consumers, including data on their expenditures, income, and consumer unit (families and single consumers) characteristics

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: current employment statistics
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: survey conducted on a regular basis that presents analytical information related to businesses and government agencies, in order to provide detailed industry data on employment, hours, and earnings of workers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: current population survey
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: survey conducted on a regular basis that presents analytical information related to the general population of a given statistical area with respect to labor force, employment, unemployment, persons not in the labor force, hours of work, earnings, and other demographic and labor force characteristics

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employment situation establishment survey
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: survey conducted on a regular basis that presents analytical information related to the labor force of a given statistical area, surveyed with respect to businesses, and is, for the most part, seasonally adjusted

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employment situation household survey
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a survey conducted on a regular basis that presents analytical information related to the labor force of a given statistical area, surveyed with respect to households, and is, for the most part, seasonally adjusted

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: employment situation survey
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a survey conducted on a regular basis that presents analytical information focused on the employment characteristics of a given statistical area

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: point of purchase survey
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a program conducted on a regular basis that provides information on purchases of various items and services by consumers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: U.S. producer price index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an economic indicator representing a measure of the change over time in the selling prices received by domestic producers for their output

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: urban consumer price index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an economic indicator representing a measure of the average change over time in the prices paid by urban consumers for a market basket of consumer goods and services

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: urban consumers universe
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a statistical universe for consumer expenditure surveys consisting of people within a household that make joint expenditure decisions

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency conversion service
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: foreign exchange service involving the conversion of currency of one country or group of countries for another, typically, but not always, as a counter transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency forward rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rate of exchange between two currencies for settlement at some future point in time, expressed as a premium on the spot rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency forward rate volatility
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of exchange rate fluctuation based on a range of projected values for exchange rates

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency spot buy rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicative spot buying market rate as observed by the reporting source

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency spot mid rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicative middle market (mean of spot buying and selling) rate as observed by the reporting source

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency spot rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rate at which one currency may be exchanged for another for immediate delivery

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency spot sell rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicative spot selling market rate as observed by the reporting source

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency spot volatility
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of exchange rate fluctuation based on a range of past actual values for exchange rates

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exchange rate structure
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structured collection of quoted or projected exchange rates, such that volatility may be constructed for the structure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exchange rate volatility
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical measure of the rate of change in the rate at which one currency can be exchanged for another

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: foreign exchange service
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service involving the exchange of one currency for another, conversion of one currency for another, and transfer of money from one country to another whereby currency conversion is required

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: international electronic funds transfer service
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: electronic funds transfer (EFT) service involving the transfer of funds across national borders, that may also involve currency conversion

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: quoted exchange rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exchange rate quoted at a specific point in time, for a given block amount of currency as quoted against another (base) currency

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: daily average market rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: overall level of a given rate, calculated as the sum of some selected observed values of the rates for a particular reference rate, foreign exchange rate, lending rate, or other market rate divided by the number of samples collected over the course of a twenty-four (24) hour period for a specific date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: end-of-day market rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: value of a given market rate of the end of the business day for a specific date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: historical price volatility
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: historical volatility measure of past trading ranges of prices of underlying securities and indexes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: historical volatility
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of volatility that uses actual values for pricing, rates, and other measurements calculated over some prior period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: implied price volatility
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of volatility that represents the expected fluctuations of an underlying stock or index over a specific time frame

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: implied volatility
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of volatility that is a forward-looking metric used to calculate probability

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: value of a rate established in the marketplace for a set of instruments or that describes the economic climate for an industry and/or political region (e.g., SOFR, Prime)

annotations.example: Financial market rates include, but are not limited to reference rates, foreign exchange rates, lending rates, bankers' acceptance rates, and so forth.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market spread
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical measure providing the difference (or spread) between two market rates

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: price structure
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structured collection of prices, such as market prices for some index or security, such that volatility or other analyses may be performed over the structure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: price volatility
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical measure of the rate of change in pricing for a given security or market index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: quoted price
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a monetary price quoted by some publisher on a given date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: term structure
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structured collection of rates, such as interest rates, or bond yields with different terms to maturity, such that a yield curve may be constructed for the structure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: volatility
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: statistical measure of the dispersion around the average of some random variable over some period of time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: base rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basic rate of interest on which the actual rate a bank charges on loans to its customers is calculated

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interbank bid rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: interbank rate that is the interest rate at which participating banks are willing to borrow deposits from other banks

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interbank mid rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: interbank rate that represents the mid-point between bid and offer rates

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interbank offered rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: interbank rate that is the interest rate at which participating banks lend money

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interbank rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: reference rate that is the rate of interest charged on short-term loans between banks

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interest rate authority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial service provider/publisher responsible for specifying some benchmark interest rate

annotations.example: This is typically a bank, central bank in the case of the publication of bank interest rates, or the committee responsible for publishing interbank rates, such as EURIBOR.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interest rate benchmark
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for regularly updated interest rates that are publicly accessible, typically set by a central bank or group of financial institutions

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interest rate benchmark classification scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheme for classifying interest rate benchmarks, such as the FpML classification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: overnight rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: reference rate that is an interest rate at which a depository institution lends funds to another depository institution (short-term), or the interest rate the central bank charges a financial institution to borrow money overnight

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: reference interest rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: market rate that is a rate of interest paid by or agreed among some bank or set of banks

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: specific-provider interest rate benchmark
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: interest rate benchmark that is made available by a specific market data provider for reference purposes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: basket of credit risks
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basket of instruments, legal entities, or a combination thereof collected for the purpose of analyzing risk

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: basket of equities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basket of securities whose constituents are listed shares

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: capitalization-based weighting function
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: weighting function derived from the relative market capitalization (share price times the number of shares outstanding) of the companies tracked by an index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: credit index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: reference index that is a function of credit events that change the value of an underlying portfolio

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: credit index constituent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: constituent of a basket of credit risks

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: equity index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: benchmark whose constituents are exclusively equity instruments

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market capitalization
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: expression representing the perceived value of a company as determined by the stock market at a specific point in time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: reference index
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of change in the value of the contents of a basket over a given period of time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: all borrowers' monthly income
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: total monthly qualifying income for all borrowers on the loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: borrower assessment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: assessment report detailing information about the borrower and their credit history that may be relevant to the loan application

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: borrower monthly income
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: total monthly qualifying income of a potential borrower

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: credit risk assessment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: risk assessment that focuses on determining the likelihood of a potential borrower repaying a loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: income verification report
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: report providing the methodology and supporting documentation used to verify the borrower's income

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: individual person credit rating
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: credit rating that provides an opinion of the creditworthiness of a person

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: loan application
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: request by a potential borrower to a potential lender to borrow money containing information used to decide whether to grant the loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pre-approval contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: written commitment to lend when specified conditions are met, such as finding suitable property, and unchanged creditworthiness

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pre-approval request
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: request from a potential borrower that a lender commit to pre-approving the borrower for a loan of up to a specified amount of money

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: public record
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: record about an action involving a party that is publicly available from a court or other government agency

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: public record category
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier of public records relevant to a loan application, e.g. tax lien, wage garnishment, foreclosure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: total debt expense ratio
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio of all monthly debt payments of all borrowers, including proposed expenses, with respect to the income of the borrowers as relied upon to make a credit decision

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underwriting automation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier indicating whether a loan was underwritten manually or using an automated underwriting system

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underwriting decision
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier providing a loan approval recommendation determined either manually or by an automated underwriting system

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: collateral valuation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: assessment activity resulting in the valuation of real property as collateral

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: court judgment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: decision by a court or other tribunal that resolves a controversy and determines the rights and obligations of the parties

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal proceeding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal step or action taken at the direction of, or by the authority of, a court or agency

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: closed-end credit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: credit agreement in which the loan principal cannot be increased after funds are dispersed in full when the loan closes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: collateralized loan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: secured loan that is secured with cash or other acceptable collateral (real property, securities or other assets) provided by the borrower as specified in the collateral agreement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: co-maker
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that signs a borrower's promissory note, providing additional security and potentially improving the quality of the debt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: combined loan-to-value ratio
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio of the total amount of debt that is secured by the asset(s) and the appraised value of the asset(s) securing the financing

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: guaranteed loan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: loan that is secured with respect to repayment of principal and interest by guaranty

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: individual payment transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: actual payment of principal, interest, fees, or other related amounts towards fulfillment of a debt obligation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lender lien position
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier indicating whether the lender has the primary lien position with respect to an asset used as collateral for the loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: loan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt instrument whereby one party extends money or credit to another party (or parties) with the understanding that the borrowed money will be repaid according to the terms of the contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: loan payment schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: regular or explicit (ad hoc) payment schedule associated with a given loan-specific account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: loan-specific customer account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: account held by the borrower associated with a specific loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: loan-to-value ratio
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio, expressed as a percentage, between the principal amount of the loan and the appraised value of the asset securing the financing

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: open-end credit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: credit agreement that may be extended up to an agreed credit limit and paid down at any time within the period of the line, if any, and on which interest is charged only on the outstanding balance

annotations.example: Credit card and overdraft lines of credit are among the most widely used forms of open-end credit.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ownership interest
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier indicating the nature of the applicant's or borrower's ownership or leasehold interest in an asset used as collateral for the loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: payment history
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: record of actual payments of principal, interest, and other related amounts made by a borrower to a lender or servicer in order to fulfill their re-payment obligation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pre-payment terms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: principal repayment terms related to payment of the loan prior to maturity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: secured loan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: loan in which the borrower pledges some asset via a security agreement as collateral for the loan, or that is secured via third-party guarantee

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: servicer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that collects principal and interest payments on behalf of the lender

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: total outstanding principal
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the principal balance of all loans secured by the property

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unsecured loan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: loan granted based on the strength of the borrower's credit history or reputation in the community

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: consumer credit reference agency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Applicable regulations: vary by jurisdiciton. for example, only being allowed ot divulge actual judgements against a party, but not things that are not substantiated by judgements. For example, slow payments which are not covered by some judgement against the party. There will be different regulatory requirments about: 1. What the CR Agency can hold 2. Who they can divulge it to 3. What information they must provide the borrower at his/her request Some of the third thing there is covered in the EU the Data Protection Directive and local acts that implement this.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: consumer credit requirement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Requirement set out on the lender about how they must treat the appliction to a loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: consumer protection agency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Some agency tasked with regulating consumer protection in some jurisdiction.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: credit reference agency requirements
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: REquirements other than data protection, governing what a credit reference agency can or cannot do.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: data protection requirement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Requirements defining how data about individuals is held. Example is the EU DA directive and laws, which make the data the property of the individual that data is about. Covers - what information i sheld - who information can be divulged to. - the individual's rights in respect of that information Privacy regulations cover most of this. EU defines "Personal Data" and "Sensitive Personal Data". For credit reference agencies the latter would be covered. More detail about whether they can divulge facts which are not subject to formal judgements etc.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: disclosure requirement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Requirement for disclosure to borrowers or potential borrowers. There are two kinds of disclosure requirement: 1. Disclosure about the information held on the borrower 2. Disclsure about the product.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: equal treatment right
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The right to equal treatment under the law.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: good faith estimate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GFE - representation by the lender on the costs and implications of settlement (early termination) of the loan.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: information right
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The right to some information in some context, for example when purchasing some product. The right to full and fair disclosure of

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lender right
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Rights on the lender to protect them against loss. furthe rNtoes: Logically, considering the two parties, they both have protecxtion mechanisms. so while the lender has protecxtion mechanisms through mortgage insurance, and the consumer has protextion mechanisms such as good faith estimates. also the agencies (see Consumer Protection Agency), an instance of which is the CFPB in the US (just set up). Lender rights are: - expressed in the Contract Consumer protection develops becaues the contract is written by the potential Lender. So the rights are introcued to rectify the imbalance between the two parties. Same goes for insurance. consumer protection laws (governe dby the relevant consumer protection agency. So the lender protexts itself as it writes th contract AND does the things it needs to do to protext itself, but on the approval process, and with later instruments such as insurance. Interestingly., it is the Borrower who pays for this by paying for credit reports etc. So the borrower protects itself by other mechanisms. Caveat emptor - displaced by regulation (the buyer is protected by regulation). Uberimae Fidae - in the utmost good faith. Mortgage Insurance is an additional means of mitigating the risk, that the lended may have., so if the information assessed is not accurate, or if the borrower's situation changes for the worse. then the risk rating may go down. So the Mortgage Insurance is a further strategy which mitigates any shortfall in the Lender Righrs that you may have - ie someone guarantees. In the US you can also avoid that by having paid a deposit. PIMI: Principal, Interst and Morgage Insurance. So the Borrower pays towards the MI, esxcept if they have paid a given amount as deposit. there are 2 types of MI: 1. protects the lender in the event of borrower degault 2. Insurance for "Incapacity to pay the mortage" (these can be bought off the shelf - can combine health, unemployment etc.). - this is the Borrower mitigating their own risk. Prevents foreclosure. Similar to general sickness etc. Where the lender charges for MI, the cost is passed onto the Borrower. e.g. if there is a % valuation (e.g. 70% in Aus, 80% in US for example) then no insurance is required.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: debt convexity analytic
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The second derivative of a security's price with respect to its yield, divided by the security's price. A security exhibits positive convexity when its price rises more for a downward move in its yield than its price declines for an equal upward move in its yield. Further notes: A measure of the change in price for a given change in Modified Duration. This always (necessarily) refers to Modified Duration. This is used as another risk measurement. Numerator is always (a) duration - either MacCaulays or Modified. Always rate of change of (one of the) Duration against some other parameter. The other paramater can be characterised as a Yield (it may be the Price, but that has a relationship to the Yield in any case). REVIEW: Inconsistency in the above - is it always necessarily Modified Duration that is referred to, or "any" Duration measure (Macaulays and.or Modified)? notes 9 Dec A measure of the sensitivity of the price with reference to interest rates. This is normally determined with reference to maturity, but since there are different maturity dates, this figure gives an estimate of the equitvalent if you had a homogenous portfolio, i.e. this is an estimate based on a pure equivalent, homogenous portfolio. Convexity of instrument versus portfolio. Sees instrument in terms of the set of cashflows. The term Convexity can be applied either to a bond or to a portfolio. More notes: When you get Convexit in MD, it will tell you what Duration it is refrfering to, along with Redemption Date (logically). Also if there is Option Adjusted Yield, there is a third set of analytics. What are they? i.e. OA Convexity, Duration Yield and the rest. Conclusions: Agreed to revisit this in OTC.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: cashflow c d o
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A cash-flow CDO is analogous to a CMO. Cash flows from collateral are used to pay principal and interest to investors. If such cash flows prove inadequate, principal and interest is paid to tranches according to seniority. At any point in time, all immediate obligations to a given tranch are met before any payments are made to less senior tranches.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: collateralized debt obligation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structured finance constructed from a portfolio of fixed income assets including corporate loans and mortgage backed securities. A special purpose vehicle (SPV) issues notes to investors in order to raise funds that are invested in a portfolio of those fixed income assets, held by the SPV as collateral for the notes. Further notes: Collateralized Debt Obligation, for example, ABS CDO which consists of a portfolio of different ABS bonds, and the payments to the holders of these trust certificates are derived from the cash flows of the ABS bonds. This CDO instrument is part of a CDO issue, consisting of individual CDO instruments of a given seniority. Often referred to as tranches and slices (Investopedia). Investopedia: Similar in structure to a collateralized mortgage obligation (CMO) or collateralized bond obligation (CBO), CDOs are unique in that they represent different types of debt and credit risk. In the case of CDOs, these different types of debt are often referred to as 'tranches' or 'slices'. Each slice has a different maturity and risk associated with it. The higher the risk, the more the CDO pays. Further details: Collateralized Debt obligations are securitized interests in pools of - generally non-mortgage - assets. Assets - called collateral - usually comprise loans or debt instruments. A CDO may be called a collateralized loan obligation (CLO) or collateralized bond obligation (CBO) if it holds only loans or bonds, respectively. Investors bear the credit risk of the collateral. Multiple tranches of securities are issued by the CDO, offering investors various maturity and credit risk characteristics.
