https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: regular floater tranche
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A floater tranche is a tranche that is keyed to an index and a spread. The spread is added to the index.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: residual tranche
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Unknown Further notes: Verify whether Residual Tranche and Support Tranche are meant to be in the same list of types as PAC etc. i.e. can a tranche not be PAC and Residual? this looks suspicioulsy like two semantics.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: senior c d o tranche
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The most senior tranche of the CDO issue. Typically rated A to AAA. If there are defaults or the CDO's collateral otherwise underperforms, scheduled payments to senior tranches take precedence over those of mezzanine tranches.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: senior m b s tranche
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Specific kinds of tranche are modeled for example and investigation only and have been removed from the diagrams. These will be removed from the final model.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: static c d o
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A CDO where collateral is fixed through the life of the CDO. The reference assets are bought and then are kept untouched for the term of the product.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: static c d o portfolio
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A portfolio where collateral of the CDO is fixed through the life of the CDO. The reference assets are bought and then are kept untouched for the term of the product.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: subordinated c d o equity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The subordinated (also known as equity) CDO tranche is the most junior tranche in the CDO issue. If there are defaults or the CDO's collateral otherwise underperforms, scheduled payments to senior and mezzanine tranches take precedence over those to subordinated/equity tranches.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: subordinated m b s tranche
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Specific kinds of tranche are modeled for example and investigation only and have been removed from the diagrams. These will be removed from the final model.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: super p o tranche
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Principal Only tranche. This tranche will only pay principal. Not clear how this is distinct from generic PO.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: super senior c d o tranche
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A tranche at the very top of a CDO Issue.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: support tranche
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A tranche which provides payment support to a PAC Tranche.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: t a c tranche
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Targeted Amortization Class. This is related to a PAC tranche and has a payment schedule geared towards a specified prepayment speed (called the pricing speed). Agency CMO

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: t a c tranche amortization schedule
tranche rating at issue
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The rating at issue of a tranche of a security. Note this is under review

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tranche type
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the type of tranche in a tranched MBS security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tranched m b s deal prospectus
trigger event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Any event where some value passes some threashold. Or some other type of business event. This is not restricted to "trigger" in the sense of a value passing a threshold. Can also be an seen such as a CDO manager going into bankruptcy.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pass through m b s deal
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An issue of Mortgage Backed Security instruments in which payments on the pool are passed through to investors

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pass through m b s deal prospectus
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The written prospectus for an agency, pass through issue of Mortgage Backed Securities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pass through m b s instrument
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A security in which the cash flows from the underlying asset pool are passed through to the investor by way of redemption payments.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: asset-backed security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt instrument backed by receivables other than those arising out of real estate loans or mortgages

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: call event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an event associated with the call schedule for a debt instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: call feature
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: redemption provision defining the rights of the issuer to buy back a security at a call price after a call protection period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: call notification provision
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: provision of a call feature defining notification requirements

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: call premium
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the price over par paid by an issuer to redeem securities when exercising a call provision

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: call schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a schedule of call prices and when they are in effect

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: call window
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an explicit period of time prior to a call date during which an issuer or agent must give notice to holders

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fixed income security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: tradeable debt instrument that provides a return in the form of fixed periodic payments and typically the return of principal at maturity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fully-indexed interest rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a variable interest rate that is calculated by adding a margin to a specified index rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: interest-only strip
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a strip that represents the non-principal portion of the monthly payments on the underlying debt instrument, such as a bond

annotations.example: An interest-only strip can be reintegrated into other synthetic or engineered products. For example, interest-only strips can be pooled to create or make up a portion of a larger collateralized mortgage obligation (CMO), asset-backed security (ABS) or collateralized debt obligation (CDO) structure.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: issued debt
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt that is set out by the borrower in some form of financial security in which the lender is the holder or counterparty of that security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: make whole feature
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a call provision allowing the issuer to pay off remaining debt early

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: margin
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a variable that is added to a specified index rate to determine the fully indexed interest rate charged to a borrower on a credit balance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: non-tradable debt instrument
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a debt instrument that may not be bought or sold

annotations.example: Low-risk instruments such as savings bonds are examples of nonnegotiable debt instruments.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: notification provision
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: provision of a redemption feature defining notification requirements

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: prescriptive event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: event related to the imposition or enforcement of a rule, method, formula, etc.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: principal-only strip
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a strip that represents the principal portion of the monthly payments on the underlying debt instrument, such as a bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: publicly issued debt
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an issued debt in the form of a tradable debt instrument (security)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: put event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an event associated with the put schedule for a debt instrument, i.e., an event involving the 'put', or surrender of the instrument by the holder

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: put notification provision
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a provision of a put feature defining notification requirements

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: put premium
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an amount over par that a debt instrument holder must pay to sell the security early

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: put schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a schedule that defines the events associated with the put feature of a debt instrument, i.e, the dates on which the debt instrument may be sold at what price by the holder

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: put window
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an explicit period of time prior to a put date during which holder or agent must give notice to an issuer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: redemption event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a prescriptive event involving the return of an investor's principal in a fixed-income security, such as a preferred stock or bond, or the sale of units in a mutual fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: relative price
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security price specified in comparison with either a stated or market value for a debt instrument at some point in time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: step event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: event that prescribes a change in a contractual term, such as a rate or notional amount, for a given contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: step schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: schedule specifying the date(s) and change in a contractual term(s), e.g., rate or notional amount, for a contract that has a feature where stipulated changes occur at specified intervals or on specified dates

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: strip
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a tradeable debt instrument created either through the process of removing coupons from a bond and then selling the separate parts as a zero coupon bond and an interest paying coupon bond or through taking the opposite position from some variant in the options market

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: variable income security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: tradeable debt instrument that provide their owners with a rate of return that is dynamic and determined by market forces

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: administrative agent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: role of a financial institution (often one of the primary lenders in the syndicate) designated to act as an intermediary between the borrowers and the syndicate lenders

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bookrunner
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution (typically a commercial or investment bank) responsible for coordinating the arrangement, structuring, and marketing of the loan to potential lenders

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: documentation agent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution designated to oversee the drafting, negotiation, and finalization of the loan documentation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: finance syndicate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: group of financial institutions or lenders that collectively agree to provide funding for a large loan to a single borrower

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: finance syndicate member
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: syndicate member that is a financial services provider that contributes funds to a syndicated loan or loan participation note

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lead arranger
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution that spearheads the loan structuring and syndication process on behalf of the borrower

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: loan participation note
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: credit facility and fixed-income security that may be distributed across a group of lenders

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: syndicated loan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: credit agreement in which a group of lenders, known as a syndicate, collectively provides a large loan to a single borrower

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: syndication agent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial institution (typically a commercial or investment bank) designated to help structure, arrange, and manage the loan syndication process

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: American exercise terms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exercise terms that stipulate that an option may be exercised on or before the date of expiration

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Bermudan exercise terms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exercise terms that stipulate that an option may only be exercised on predetermined dates within some exercise window, often on one day each month or at the date of expiration

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: canary exercise terms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exercise terms that stipulate that an option may only be exercised on predetermined dates until the first step is reached, but not after that point

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: European exercise terms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: exercise terms that stipulate that an option may only be exercised at the date of expiration

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exercise convention
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention that determines when the holder or future holder of an option can implement the rights defined in the option

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exercise terms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract terms specific to the conditions, conventions and other stipulations related to the exercise of an option or entitlement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: agency m b s deal
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An issue of securities backed by pools of mortgages held by government agencies.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: agency m b s issuer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The issuer of the pass through MBS is an Agency issuer. This is identified as being some kind of agency that is set up specifically to issue these instruments.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: agency m b s pool
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A pool investment consisting of a collection of Agency MBS instruments.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: agency mortgage pool
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A pool of agency mortgages.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: government mortgage agency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An agency set up by a government for the purpose of issuing mortgages.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: issued and securitized agency mortage pool
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An agency mortgage pool which has been securitized as part of an agency Mortgage Backed Security.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: issued and securitized non agency mortgage pool
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A non agency mortgage pool which has been securitized as part of a tranched Mortgage Backed Security.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: m b s issuer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The issuer of a Mortgage Backed Security.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: m b s pool
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A pool investment consisting of a collection of MBS instruments.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mortgage-backed security offering prospectus
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Prospectus describing the terms of the issue and each of the instruments included in the mortgage backed security issue. Term origin:SMER

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mortgage pool
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: loan pool consisting of mortgages that are held in trust as collateral for the issuance of a mortgage-backed security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: non agency m b s issuer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A party which is a non agency issuer of MBS securities. The identity of this party may be a bank or a specialist (non agency) mortgage company. Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pass through m b s instrument note
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An individual note of a pass through instrument.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pass through m b s issue underwriter
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The party which agrees to buy any certificates that are not bought by investors Term origin:MBS PoC Reviews

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private label m b s deal
real estate mortgage investment conduit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: special purpose vehicle that pools mortgage loans together and issues mortgage-backed securities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: residential m b s
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Residential Mortgage-Backed Securities, which are trust certificates (bonds) backed by a pool of residential mortgage loans.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: specialist mortgage issuer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A business organization that specialises in and exists for the issuance of mortgages to the general public.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: absolute prepayment rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: measure of the monthly rate of loan prepayments as a percentage of the original pool balance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: attachment point
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: lower tranche boundary of a tranche defined as a percentage of the value of the total pool of collateral, either at issuance or as of some point in time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: debt pool statistical measure
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: qualified measure of some aspect of the behavior of one or more debt instrument(s) that may vary over time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: default rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: qualified measure of the rate at which holders of the debt instruments in the pool default on those instruments

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: detachment point
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: upper tranche boundary of a tranche defined as a percentage of the value of the total pool of collateral, either at issuance or as of some point in time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pool-backed security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: debt instrument that derives its cashflow from an underlying pool of mortgage loans or other receivables

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: single monthly mortality
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: estimated per-month percentage of mortgages in an MBS pool that will be paid off early

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: structured finance without principal protection
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structured finance that is a short-term note linked to an underlying asset that offers a steady stream of income

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tranche
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: segment of a pool of securities, typically debt instruments

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: weighted average coupon
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: weighted-average gross interest rates of the pool of mortgages that underlie a mortgage-backed security (MBS) weighed by their balances at the time the securities were issued

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: weighted average life
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: weighted average of the times of the principal repayments Average life is calculated using the weighted average time to the receipt of all future cash flows.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: weighted average loan age
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: dollar-weighted average measuring the age of the individual loans in a mortgage pass-through or pooled security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: weighted average maturity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: weighted average amount of time until the maturities on mortgages in a mortgage-backed security (MBS)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: weighted average remaining term
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: weighted average time to maturity of a portfolio of asset-backed securities (ABS) or mortgage-backed (MBS) securities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: arbitrage synthetic c d o
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Arbitrage synthetic CDO deals are motivated by regulatory or practical considerations that might make a bank want to retain ownership of debt while achieving capital relief through CDSs. In this case, the sponsoring bank has a portfolio of obligations, called the reference portfolio. It retains that portfolio, but offloads its credit risk by transacting CDSs with the CDO.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: synthetic amortizing security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Security constructed to emulate an amortizing security.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: synthetic balance sheet c d o
synthetic c d o portfolio constituent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An instrument which is defined as a constituent of a synthetic pool of instruments. These are not holdings because they are not held, but in all other respects they are the constituents of the portfolio.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: synthetic debt instrument pool
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A cash flow structure which synthesizes the behavior of a portfolio of debt securities. For example a synthesized portfolio of CDO / Bonds / ABS using Total Returns Swaps and CDS. This does exist, it is just manufactured from different instruments.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: synthetic debt instrument pool funding asset
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An asset which provides the funding for a synthetic debt instrument pool, as used in a synthetic CDO.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: synthetic debt s p v
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A Special Purpose Vehicle set up for the issuance of synthetics CDOs. This entity (like all SPVs) its itself registered as some kind of legal entity, distinct from the sponsoring organization. It becomes the Issuer of Synthetic CDO issues.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bankers' acceptance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: short-term debt instrument that is guaranteed and paid by a bank and used as a relatively safe form of payment for large transactions

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bill of exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: short-term negotiable financial instrument consisting of an order in writing addressed by one person (the seller of goods) to another (the buyer), requiring the latter to pay a fixed amount of money on demand (a sight draft) or on a predetermined date (a time draft)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: commercial paper
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an unsecured short-term debt instrument typically issued by a bank, corporation, or foreign government to obtain funds to meet short-term debt obligations, such as accounts receivable, inventories, or payroll, backed only by an issuing bank or company promise to pay the face amount on the maturity date specified on the note

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: drawee
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that is required to pay the amount stated on the bill of exchange to the payee

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: drawer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that requires a drawee to pay either a third party or themselves with respect to a bill of exchange

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: eurodollar deposit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a certificate of deposit with a fixed interest rate issued in U.S. dollars outside the jurisdiction of the Federal Reserve, held at banks outside of the United States, including branches of U.S. banks located outside of the U.S.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: money market instrument
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a short-term debt security that gives the owner the unconditional right to receive a stated, fixed sum of money on a specified date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: repurchase agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: agreement between two parties whereby one party lends the other a security at a specified price with a commitment to take the security back at a later date for another specified price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: American depositary receipt
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: depositary receipt that represents securities of a foreign company and allows that company's securities to trade in the U.S. financial markets

annotations.example: For example, Accton Technology is traded on the Taiwanese exchange. In order for Accton Technology to be traded in the United States, Citibank, acting as a domestic custodian bank, purchases shares of Accton Technology and creates a security, ISIN US00437R1032, which can be traded on a U.S. exchange, in this case PORTAL. Note that the depositary shares do not have to equal the number of original shares. In the case of Accton Technology, one depositary share is equivalent to two original shares.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: American depositary receipt level
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for American depositary receipts that categorizes ADRs into levels based on the extent to which the foreign company has access to the U.S. market

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: American depositary receipt level scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for American depositary receipts that categorizes ADRs into levels based on the extent to which the foreign company has access to the U.S. market

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Chinese depositary receipt
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: global depositary receipt that represents ownership in the securities of a non-Chinese company that trades on a public exchange in China

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: depositary receipt
