https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: listed share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share that is listed on at least one platform

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: nil paid share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share whose payment status indicates that none of the market value has been received by the company for the shares

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: non-cumulative preferred share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share whose dividend payments are not carried forward

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: non-participating preferred share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share that is not a participating preferred share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: non-voting share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share that has no voting right

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ordinary dividend
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: dividend that is paid to shareholders periodically

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: partially paid share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share whose payment status indicates that only a portion of the market value has been received by the company for the shares

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: participating preferred share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share that, in addition to paying a stipulated dividend, gives the holder the right to participate with common share holders in additional distributions of earnings under specified conditions

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: perpetual preferred share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share that has no fixed maturity date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: precedence right
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: right that give the shareholder higher priority with respect to certain pre-defined dividend payments over other shareholders and that pay out first in the case of liquidation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: preferred dividend
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: commitment to distribute a portion of earnings to shareholders, similar to a dividend but often with a fixed payment amount and schedule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: preferred share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share that pays dividends at a specified rate and has preference over common shares in the payment of dividends and liquidation of corporate assets

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: preferred share with adjustable rate dividend
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share whose dividend rate varies according to some benchmark

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: preferred share with auction rate dividend
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share whose dividend rate is periodically reset through an auction, such as a Dutch auction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: preferred share with fixed maturity date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share whose maturity date is set, typically according to the terms of the prospectus

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: preferred share with fixed rate dividend
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share whose dividends are set, typically according to the terms of the prospectus

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: price per share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: price for one share of a given security at some point in time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: privately held share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share in a security that signifies ownership in an entity that is not publicly traded

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: qualified dividend
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: dividend that falls under capital gains tax rates that are lower than the income tax rates on unqualified (ordinary) dividends

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: redeemable preferred share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share that gives the issuer the right to redeem the stock under specified conditions

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: redeemable preferred share with extendable maturity date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: redeemable preferred share with a fixed maturity date whose issuer has the option to extend the maturity date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: redeemable preferred share with extendable redemption date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: redeemable preferred share whose redemption date can be modified

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: restricted share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share whose ownership/transfer/sale is subject to special conditions including country-specific restrictions

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: restricted voting share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share that confers less than one vote per share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: retractable preferred share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: preferred share that gives the owner (shareholder) the right to redeem the stock under specified conditions

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: retractable preferred share with extendable maturity date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: retractable preferred share with a fixed maturity date whose issuer and/or holders have the option to extend the maturity date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: retractable preferred share with extendable redemption date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: retractable preferred share whose redemption date can be modified

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial instrument that signifies a unit of equity ownership in a corporation, or a unit of ownership in a mutual fund, or interest in a general or limited partnership, or a unit of ownership in a structured product, such as a real estate investment trust

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: share issuer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: issuer of securities that represent an ownership interest in something

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: share payment status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier that specifies the overall payment status for shares issued

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: share yield
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ratio of the annualized dividend per share divided by the (current) price per share

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: single voting share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share that has the right to exactly one vote

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: soft retractable preferred share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: retractable preferred share whose retraction value may be paid in cash or in an equal value of common stock of the issuer, at the option of the issuer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: special dividend
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: dividend that is paid to shareholders on a one-time basis

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unrestricted share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share whose ownership/transfer/sale is not subject to special conditions including country-specific restrictions

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: variable interest entity share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: share that certifies ownership of a contractual right to a percentage of a company's profits

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: voting right
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contractual right that specifies shareholder voting entitlements, such as to elect directors, elect outside auditors, and vote on matters of corporate policy

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: accumulating share class
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A share class in which there is no option to reinvest.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: asset class strategy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Strategy which is asset class based.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: common share in fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A share unit in a fund, which is classified as a Common Share class.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: currency strategy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Strategy which is currency based.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: equity fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A fund which invests in at least 85% shares.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: equity portfolio
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A portfolio which has at least 85% exposure to shares.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fonds commun de placement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: open-ended collective investment fund, which is a contractual form set up between the fund manager and investors and not a separate legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund accountant
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The party that keeps accounting records of the available assets and liabilities of the Fund. It calculates dealing prices, the Net Asset Value (NAV) of the Fund, and may provide fund performance and tax data. Can be subcontracted by the FundAdministrator.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund bond class unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A fund unit which takes the form of debt in that fund.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund bond unit coupon
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A fixed coupon paid out to holders of the Fund Bond Unit.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund cash distribution policy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Policy for distribution of cash dividends or notes in the event that the fund units have a distribution policy of "Cash" rather than "Reinvestment".

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund classification
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The category of the fund according to the asset class. This is a published code by which the Fund is classified. Further notes: Could be EFCF codes. This is the way in which "Type of fund" is articulated.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund classification scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A published scheme for the category of a fund according to the asset class.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund coupon policy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Terms for the expected distribution of bond unit coupons.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund depositary
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The party that holds and safeguards holdings owned by a fund. It is also responsible for compliance of the portfolio with legal ratios etc.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund distribution policy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: policy indicating the overall strategy or limitations on distribution for the fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund distributor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an entity through which a fund may be bought by or for an investor. This may be on a discretionary or advisory basis, or as an execution-only service. Definition origin:EFAMA DD

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund dividend policy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Terms for the expected distributions of dividends.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund investment objective
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The aim of a Fund e.g outperfom a given benchmark.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund investment policy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: policy that the fund implements in order to achieve the stated fund objectives

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund legal form documentation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: For a fund which is constituted under the law of contract, the constitution or articles that define the fund. These are embodied in a Contract.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund order desk
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The Fund Order Desk is a party to the Fund Order Desk Account.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund portfolio
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An account containing a number of financial instruments along with cash positions in one or more currencies and belonging to a Fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund portfolio investment limitations
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Detailed Policy on approximately how the portfolio is to be allocated to achieve the stated investment goals. This underpins the detailed strategy of how to achieve this.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund portfolio investment policy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: policy with respect to allocation of the portfolio that is designed to meet the stated investment strategy and goals

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund processing general terms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Formal terms for general processing of the fund. These set out what the investor and the fund may or may not do.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund processing terms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Formal terms for processing of the fund. These set out what the investor and the fund may or may not do. These include terms for redemption and subscription processing as well as general processing terms. ISO FIBIM definition: Processing characteristics linked to the instrument, ie, not to the market.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund redemption terms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Formal terms for redemption of units in the fund. These set out what the investor and the fund may or may not do.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund reinvestment policy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Terms for the expected reinvestment of profits on fund units.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund share class unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The legal structure in which you can purchase part of an investment pool, defined by a variety of characteristics like investor type, minimum size of investment, distribution type, fee and currency. A fund unit which gives the holder an equity stake in the fund.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund subscription terms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Subscription terms for the fund. Further notes: ISO FIBIM, EFAMA DD and FPP combine terms for subscription, redemption and general holding requirements. These have been separated here as they are different kinds of term, but this can be reviewed. Subscription Terms are identified as terms of the fund and not the fund unit, since terms for how you might subscribe can't be binding one someone who has not yet subscribed.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund supervisory authority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that supervises the fund or fund industry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund transfer agent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An entity that undertakes the execution of subscription, redemption and switch orders on behalf of a fund. Definition origin:EFAMA DD

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund unit distribution method
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The normal distribution policy for funds.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund unit distribution policy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: policy relating to the unit, e.g. if income is paid out or retained in the fund and how this is treated, including distribution policy details for dividends and coupons.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: funds cash distribution
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Accrued income is distributed periodically to the investor.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: funds processing
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The context of managing and processing funds, issuing funds units etc. This is the context in which the different parties involved in a fund are defined as parties.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: funds processing account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: An account used specifically in the processing of funds. Like all accounts this is (per FIBIM definition) a business relationship between two entities; one entity is the account owner, the other entity is the account servicer. Please refer to Financial global model for treatment of accounts relationships in this model.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: funds processing party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party involved in the processing of funds

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: income accumulation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Accrued income is not distributed and instead remains reflected within the unit/share price.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund investment restrictions set
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Limitations that apply to the fund as a whole, such as risk factors. these are used to determine whether the fund is appropriate for a given type of investor to invest in.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investment strategy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: plan, method, or series of maneuvers or stratagems for obtaining a specific investment goal

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: jurisdiction strategy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Strategy which is jurisdiction based.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: key investor information document
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: short document that provides critical information for investors, summarizing content derived from a prospectus such that it can be understood by investors without reference to other documents, as required by law in the European Union

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: net asset value calculation method
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Parameters for the calculation of the net asset value for an investment fund/fund class.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: note fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: pooled investment vehicle that issues debt instruments (notes) to investors rather than (or in addition to) traditional equity interests

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: note fund share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment interest in a fund that issues notes rather than traditional equity, in cases where the fund is structured as a company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: note fund unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment interest in a fund that issues notes rather than traditional equity, in cases where the fund is structured as a trust, partnership, or unitized fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: organization strategy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Strategy which is organization based.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: other investment fund information
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Things which are not part of the prospectus but are important if you want to understand the fund.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: portfolio benchmark
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Security or other price against which the performance of the portfolio is evaluated.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: portfolio investment strategy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The manner in which the portfolio manager tries to reach the funds objectives.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private equity holding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A holding of private equity.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: real estate holding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: tangible asset consisting of real estate that is owned or controlled by an individual, organization, or entity for investment, operational, or strategic purposes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: refer to fund order desk
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Restriction requiring an investor to refer to the fund order desk prior to redeeming a fund.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: s i c a f
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A French fund vehicle type. Designation and definition needed.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: s i c a v
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Societe Collective a Capital Variable

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sector strategy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Strategy which is sector based.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unit issuer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The party which issues the Fund Unit.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund contract
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract that embodies and defines the fund legal form in cases where there is no independent organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: quantified share of beneficial interest in a pooled fund, representing a proportional claim on the fund's assets, income, or entitlements

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: collective investment vehicle
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: assets pooled by investors whose share capital remains separate from the assets of the vehicle

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: prospectus
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: formal, written offering document to sell securities that provides the facts an investor needs to make an informed investment decision

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: aligned community investment fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: community investment fund that raises capital publicly from community members and deploys some of that capital via investments into its client businesses or other businesses in the community

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: closed-end investment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund that has a fixed number of shares offered by an investment company through an initial public offering

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: community investment fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: professionally-managed investment fund with three essential characteristics: capital is sourced from people in the community (ideally from retail/non-accredited investors); capital is invested into local people, projects, and businesses; and capital is deployed by individuals in the community, typically but not necessarily a nonprofit fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: diversified community investment fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: community investment fund that invests primarily in real estate but can also invest in any local business or project, and can do so with investment capital raised publicly from within the fund's own community, including community investors

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exchange-traded fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund whose fund units are traded on an exchange, much like stocks

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund administrator
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: role of the party responsible for managing the operational, accounting, and compliance functions of an investment fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund holder
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that owns units in or a percentage of and has rights and responsibilities with respect to some fund, provided in exchange for investment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund holding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ownership interest in a fund, which may represented by fund units that confer financial rights and governance privileges

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund manager
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: role of the party responsible for making investment decisions and managing the portfolio of an investment fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund of funds
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund that invests directly in other investment funds rather than investing in stocks, bonds, and other securities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund position
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: position in some fund, which may be defined in terms of fund units

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: hedge fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund that pursues a total return and is usually open to qualified investors only

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal fund structure
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: structure of a fund with respect to its legal formation in some jurisdiction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mutual fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: open-end professionally managed investment fund established for the purpose of investing in securities such as stocks, bonds, money market instruments and similar assets

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: non-tradable fund unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security representing an interest in a fund that cannot be traded ontside of the fund itself

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: nonprofit fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment vehicle designed to support a nonprofit mission, whose objectives include environmental stewardship and/or social responsibility in addition to financial performance

annotations.example: Common examples include endowment funds (permanently invested, only earnings are spent), operating funds (used for day-to-day expenses), and special project funds (earmarked for particular initiatives).

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: open-end investment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund that offered through a fund company that sells shares directly to investors

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pension fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund run by a financial intermediary on behalf of an organization and its employees/members

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private credit fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment vehicle that provides loans or other forms of credit to companies, typically outside of the traditional banking system

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private equity fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund used for making investments in various equity (and to a lesser extent debt) securities according to an investment strategy associated with private equity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: real estate investment trust
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment fund that offers shares/units to the public and invests in real estate directly

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sovereign wealth fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: state-owned investment fund that consists of pools of money derived from a country's reserves

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tradable fund unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security representing a tradable interest in a fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unit trust
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: pooled investment vehicle in which investors hold units that represent beneficial ownership in a trust-managed portfolio of assets

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unitized fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: pooled investment vehicle in which investors hold units that represent a proportional share of the fund's underlying assets, typically used in pensions or insurance-based products

annotations.example: Examples include authorized unit trusts (AUTs), investment companies with variable capital (ICVCs), and insurance-linked unitized funds.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: managed investment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investment pool that is controlled by a professional investment manager who invests the pool in various financial instruments and assets that align with their investment objectives and is overseen by a board of directors

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pooled fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: pool of funds that a group of investors combines for common benefit

annotations.example: An investment club pools the funds of its members, giving them the opportunity to share in a portfolio offering greater diversification and the hope of a better return on their money than they could get individually.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: managed investment that cannot offer securities to the public

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: market basket
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basket composed of market indices

annotations.example: For example, certain equities derivatives have an underlying basket which is a basket of more than one index, not a basket of securities.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: basket Of indices constituent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: single constituent of a basket of indices

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: basket of securities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basket composed of securities, typically of a particular asset class such as equities or bonds

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mixed basket
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: basket that has a mix of constituents, including securities and indices

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: securities basket constituent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security identified as a component of a basket of securities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Basel III Designation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: European Union wide securities designation, defined by the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision (BCBS), that classifies securities based on the quality of capital underlying the instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: MiFID regulated security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security for which MiFID reporting is required

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: blue sky law
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: state-level securities regulation, designed to protect investors against securities fraud that require issuers to be registered and to disclose details of their offerings

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: auction date rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: business recurrence interval convention that is a published rule for defining the date of some auction event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: date returned by settlement date rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: calculated date that is determined via a settlement rule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: date returned by trading date rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: calculated date that is determined via a trading rule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: floating-rate note date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: calculated date associated with a floating-rate note, also known as a floater or FRN, which is a debt instrument with a variable interest rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: floating-rate note date rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: business day adjustment rule applied to floating-rate note instruments

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: International Money Market (IMM) Australian Dollar (AUD) trading date rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: trading date rule defined as the last trading day of an Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) 90-Day Bank Accepted Futures and Options product, one Sydney business day preceding the second Friday of the relevant settlement month

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: International Money Market (IMM) Canadian Dollar (CAD) trading date rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: trading date rule defined as the last trading day / expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange (Bourse do Montreal Inc.), three month Bankers' Acceptance Futures (Ticker symbol BAX), the second London banking day prior to the third Wednesday of the contract month

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: International Money Market (IMM) New Zealand Dollar (NZD) trading date rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: trading date rule defined as the last trading day of an Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) New Zealand (NZ) 90-Day Bank Accepted Futures and Options product, the first Wednesday after the ninth day of the relevant settlement month

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: International Money Market (IMM) settlement date rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: settlement date rule as defined in the International Money Market (IMM) settlement dates calendar

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: scheduled calculation period end event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the end date of a specific calculation period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: scheduled calculation period start event
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the start of a specific calculation period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: settlement date rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention for determining settlement dates by reference to some jurisdiction or as set by a given exchange or similar venue

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trading date rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention for determining trading dates defined with reference to some trading date calendar published by some trading facility or exchange

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: US Treasury bill auction date rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rule for setting auction dates for US Treasury bills

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: US Treasury bill date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: auction date for US 13 week and 26 week Treasury bills

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund family
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: collection of managed investments that are all managed by a single investment institution

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: instrument pool
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: pool consisting of financial instruments that may be included in the same investment vehicle

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: instrument pool as asset
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial asset in the form of an instrument pool

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pool
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: combination of resources for a common purpose or benefit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pool constituent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: component of a pool

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: securities pool
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: pool of securities organized for the purpose of issuing notes against those securities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: asset class
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial instrument classifier for a group of securities that exhibit similar characteristics, behave similarly in the marketplace and are subject to the same laws and regulations

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: classification of financial instruments code scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classification scheme for set of codes for financial instruments that can be used globally for straight-through processing by all involved participants in an electronic data processing environment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial instrument classification code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier and code for a financial instrument defined in the ISO 10962 Classification of Financial Instruments (CFI) Code Scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial instrument classification scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classification scheme defining a set of classifiers for financial instruments

annotations.example: the ISO 10962 Classification of Financial Instruments (CFI) classification scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial instrument classifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classifier for a financial instrument based on its type and features

annotations.example: Examples include equity instrument, debt instrument, option, future, etc. per the the ISO 10962 CFI (Classification of Financial Instruments) standard, as cash instruments or derivative instruments per the Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) and International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) accounting standards, and so forth.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Global Industry Classification Standards classifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: four-tiered standardized classification or delineation for an organization based on the principal business activity of the organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: industry classification benchmark classifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: standardized classification or delineation for an organization based on their main source of revenue

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial instrument identification scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: formal definition of the structure and application of a particular set of financial instrument identifiers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: international securities identification number
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security identifier that is defined as specified in ISO 6166, Securities and related financial instruments -- International securities identification numbering system (ISIN)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: international securities identification numbering scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: formal definition of the structure and application of a ISINs as defined in ISO 6166

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: listed security identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security identifier issued in the public domain and referred to in listings and other relevant publications

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: national numbering agency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registration authority responsible for issuing and managing National Securities Identifying Numbers for securities in accordance with the ISO 6166 standard in some jurisdiction (typically that of a country)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: National Securities Identifying Number
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: generic, nine-digit alpha numeric code which identifies a fungible security, assigned by a national numbering agency under the ISO 6166 standard

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: National Securities Identifying Number registry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registry used by a national numbering agency to manage the financial instrument identifiers and related information that it registers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: national numbering agency registry entry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entry in a National Securities Identifying Number registry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: national security identification scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security identification scheme, defining the format and structure of a National Securities Identifying Number (NSIN), published nationally on behalf of a country

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: proprietary security identification scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security identification scheme published by a commercial entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: proprietary security identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier supplied by a commercial entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: security identification scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: formal definition of the structure and application of a particular set of securities identifiers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: security identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: any publicly available identifier that is used to identify a security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: security registry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registry used to manage security identifiers and related information

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: security registry entry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: record for a security in a securities registry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ticker symbol
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: reassignable identifier of relatively short character string length that is unique within an exchange for a particular financial instrument or listing for that instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: listing
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: catalog entry for a securities offering managed by an exchange that provides the terms under which that security is made available on that exchange

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CUSIP International Numbering System (CINS) number
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: 9-character alphanumeric identifier that employs the same 9 characters as CUSIP, but also contains a letter of the alphabet in the first position signifying the issuer's country or geographic region, issued by CUSIP Global Services

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP) number
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: nine-character alphanumeric number that identifies all North American stocks and registered bonds for the purposes of facilitating clearing and settlement of trades, issued by CUSIP Global Services on behalf of the American Bankers' Association, which is a part of Standard and Poor's Capital IQ, that is the National Numbering Agency Identifier for securities issued in North America, which is also part of the ISIN for the security it identifies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: common code registry entry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entry in a common code registry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Euroclear Clearstream common code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: nine-character alphanumeric securities identifier, issued in Luxembourg, jointly by Euroclear and Clearstream

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial instrument global identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: financial instrument identifier that is defined as specified in the Object Management Group (OMG) Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI) Specification

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI) registry entry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: entry in a Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI) registry

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Refinitiv instrument code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: proprietary code for financial instruments and indices owned, managed, and distributed by the London Stock Exchange Group's LSEG Financial Solutions (branded as Refinitiv)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Stock Exchange Daily Official List (SEDOL) code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: seven-character security identifier, issued by the London Stock Exchange, that is the National Securities Identifying Number (NSIN) for securities issued in the United Kingdom, which is also part of the ISIN for the security it identifies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Telekurs Id
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifier used to identify financial instruments owned, managed, and distributed by SIX Financial Information (formerly Telekurs AG and subsequently SIX Telekurs Ltd.)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Valoren
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identification number assigned to financial instruments in Switzerland, Liechtenstein and Belgium, issued by SIX Financial Information, that is the National Securities Identifying Number (NSIN) for securities issued in those countries and is also part of the ISIN for the security it identifies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: best efforts offering
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: securities offering whereby investment bankers commit to doing their best to sell the securities offered, but do not assume the full risk of an underwriter

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: conversion terms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract terms specifying when and how a security may be converted to another security (usually of the same issuer)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: convertible security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security that can be converted into another security

annotations.example: Convertible securities may be convertible bonds or preferred stocks that pay regular interest and can be converted into shares of common stock (sometimes conditioned on the stock price appreciating to a predetermined level).

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exempt issuer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: issuer that issues securities that are excused from certain regulatory reporting requirements

annotations.example: In general, these include governments and issuers of tax exempt securities such as municipalities, banks and depository institutions, and authorized insurance companies, railroads and public utilities, and certain non-profit organizations.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exempt offering
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: public offering involving securities that are excused from certain regulatory reporting requirements

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exempt transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: securities transaction for which there is no requirement to register the transaction with a regulatory agency

annotations.example: Examples include non-issuer transactions in outstanding securities, other isolated non-issuer transactions, certain unsolicited / de minimis transactions, fiduciary transactions, transactions with financial institutions, private placement transactions that meet certain conditions, and so forth.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial instrument short name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: abbreviated name for a financial instrument within a defined structure as specified in ISO 18774

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: firm commitment offering
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: securities offering whereby the underwriter purchases the securities outright for their own account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: offering statement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: offering memorandum that conforms to Regulation A, Offering Statement, of the Securities Act of 1933

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private offering
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: offering of securities made privately to a limited number of qualified potential investors

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: private placement memorandum
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal document stating the objectives, risks and terms of investment involved with a private placement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: public offering
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: offering of securities for sale to the investment public, after compliance with registration requirements of the relevant regulatory authorities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: security form
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: nature of the proof of ownership of a security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: security underwriter
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: party that has purchased from an issuer with a view to, or sells for an issuer in connection with, the distribution of any security, or participates or has a direct or indirect participation in any such undertaking, or participates or has a participation in the direct or indirect underwriting of any such undertaking

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: security underwriting arrangement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: underwriting agreement between an organization (typically an investment bank) and a securities issuer that commits the underwriter to assuming risk involved in buying a new issue of securities and reselling it to the public

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: listed security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: registered security listed on at least one exchange

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: listing service
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: service provided by an exchange to facilitate securities trading

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: registered security
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security that is registered with some registration authority

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: contractual restriction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract terms setting out restrictions on either the holder or the issuer of the security, as specified in the terms of the instrument itself

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: individual investor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investor that is a person, rather than an organization, who may or may not be considered a qualified investor from a legal perspective

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: institutional investor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: investor that pools money to purchase securities, real property, and other investment assets or originates loans

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investors' domicile restriction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal holding restriction that specifies where holders of a security may be domiciled

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal holding restriction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security restriction applicable to holding the security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: qualified investor restriction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal holding restriction that defines the concept of a qualified investor for a given purpose and specifies that only such qualified investors may hold the security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: securities regulation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: regulation codified in law specific to securities and investments

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: securities restriction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: legal obligation that is applicable to a financial instrument or listing as mandated in a law or by contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: trading restriction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: restriction that limits trading in some manner, typically summarized on term sheets or in other documentation, including but not limited to restrictions on day trading

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has publisher
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the party in the role of issuing the information

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is published by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies the independent party (i.e., the individual or organization) that disseminates the material

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: publishes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: prepares and issues material for public consumption

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has full sovereignty over
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a polity to a geopolitical entity where the polity has absolute, supreme and ultimate dominion and authority of a political state subject to no higher power, expressed within its territory in full self-government and in complete freedom from any outside influence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has shared sovereignty over
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a polity to a geopolitical entity where the polity exercises shared dominion and authority of a political state

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has sovereignty over
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a polity to a geopolitical entity where the polity exercises dominion and authority of a political state

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is elected by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies an official or government chosen to hold office by voting

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is an instrument of
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates an instrumentality of some government to the government that it supports

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is represented by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a system of governance to its chosen representatives

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has date of incorporation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the formal date of incorporation as stated in filing documents

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has date of registration
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which the corporation has registered in some jurisdiction for regulatory and / or for tax purposes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has issued capital
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the aggregate value of all shares held by shareholders

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is constituted by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the instrument by which an entity is incorporated

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is incorporated in
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the legal jurisdiction under which the legal entity is incorporated

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has equity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates owners' equity associated with the entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has headquarters address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the main address at which communications may be delivered for the organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has operating address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates an address at which an organization carries out operations

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has registered address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies an address that is officially recorded with some government authority and at which legal papers may be served

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has legal address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the legal address for the entity, in the jurisdiction in which the entity is established, used for registration purposes with respect to obtaining an LEI

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has legal form
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the nature of the entity as defined from a legal or regulatory perspective in a given jurisdiction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is consolidated by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the entity considered the 'end node' or consolidating entity (parent) from an ISO 17442 perspective

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is consolidation of
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the entity considered the 'start node' or consolidated entity from an ISO 17442 perspective

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is directly consolidated by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates that the entity considered the 'end node' or consolidating entity (parent) fully consolidates the accounting of the 'start node' (child) per the accounting rules specified, and is the closest consolidating entity to that child in any applicable ownership hierarchy

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is an international branch of
