https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: watch direction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates direction in which an investment credit rating is expected to move in cases where that rating is on watch

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: watch outlook
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the expected outlook for the rated entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: governs payment of
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links contractual terms embedded in a contract, such as interest or repayment terms to the element those terms apply to

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has accrual basis
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies the convention that defines how interest accrues on something, that is the number of days in a month and days in a year that are counted when performing interest accrual calculations

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has amount of credit extended
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the gross amount of credit that has been provided to the borrower as of a given point in time with respect to a specific agreement (e.g. for line of credit)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has available amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates an amount of money available for an individual or organization to borrow

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has borrower
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a contract, such as a debt instrument or credit agreement, to one or more parties that are incurring the debt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has compounding frequency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the frequency at which interest is added to the principal of the debt over the course of the agreement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has credit limit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the maximum amount of credit that may be borrowed with respect to a specific agreement (e.g. for line of credit)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has debt amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the monetary amount of the debt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has denomination
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the face value of currency units, coins, or securities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has final interest payment date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the date on which the last interest payment is due

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has initial exchange date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the specific date when the initial exchange of assets or funds takes place

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has initial interest accrual date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the date from which interest begins to accrue

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has initial interest payment date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the date on which the first interest payment is due

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has initial principal payment date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the date on which the first payment against the principal is due

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has interest payment day
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the day of the month on which interest payments must be made on the debt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has interest payment frequency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the frequency at which interest payments must be made on the debt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has interest rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates something, such as an agreement, or debt instrument, to the rate (typically annual) of interest that is to be paid by the debtor to the creditor on the debt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has interest rate cap
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates something, such as an agreement, or debt instrument, to the upper bound (ceiling) rate (typically annual) of interest on variable-rate debt that is to be paid by the debtor to the creditor on the debt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has lender
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a contract, such as a debt instrument or credit agreement, to one or more parties that are financing the debt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has maturity date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which the principal amount of an instrument is due to be repaid to the investor and interest or coupon payments stop, and/or the date on which the instrument may be redeemed

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has maximum advance amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the ceiling on the amount of credit that can be drawn by the borrower in a single request with respect to a specific agreement (e.g. for line of credit) within the specified credit limit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has time to maturity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the lifespan of credit agreement or offering, from the date of issuance to the scheduled maturity date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has outstanding amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates an amount of money representing the principal, interest, or other amount owed at a specific point in time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has principal
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the face value of an obligation, such as a bond or loan, that must be repaid at maturity, i.e., the base amount raised by a mortgage or other debt instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has principal payment day
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the day of the month on which payments on the principal must be made

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has principal payment frequency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the frequency at which payments on the principal must be made

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has principal repayment date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates an instrument to the date by which the principal must be repaid in full

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is amortization of
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links the process of reduction of debt or other costs through periodic charges to the relevant asset or liability

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is based on
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates something to something else on which it rests, or that supports it in some way

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is collateralization of
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates some collateral to an agreement pledging the asset as security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is collateralized by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates an agreement to an asset pledged as security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is interest on
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a monetary amount that is the cost of using credit to the debt that it applies to

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is owed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a creditor to a debt that is outstanding and payable to them

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is owed by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a debt to the party that owes it

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is owed to
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a debt to the party to which it is payable

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is principal of
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links the value of a debt, excluding any interest or other costs of using credit, to the debt that it applies to

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: owes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a party to a debt that they owe

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has guaranteed amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates the guaranty to the monetary amount guaranteed

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has guarantor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates the guarantor to the contract for which they are providing a guaranty

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has guarantor party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a party that guarantees, endorses, or provides indemnity for some obligation on its behalf

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has priority level
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a guaranty to some relative ranking that the guaranty has in the context of the contract, for example for a credit enhancement priority

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is guaranteed by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates guaranty to the contract guarantor, i.e., to the legal person providing the guaranty

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is guarantor of
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies a party over which a guarantor has some measure of control by virtue of the guarantee

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has buying currency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the currency purchased with respect to a currency or related instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has calculation agent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a party (role) responsible for determining the value of an instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has commodity value as of execution date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the per unit value of a given commodity as of the date that the contract is executed

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has nominal value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the face value of a contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has principal executive office address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates an organization, specifically the issuer of a financial instrument, to its principal executive address, as required for issuance of that instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has redemption terms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the specific terms related to redemption as specified in the instrument or a related contract document

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has selling currency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the currency sold with respect to a currency or related instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has shareholder
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a party that holds shares in the issuer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has underlier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a derivative to something on which the contract is based

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has value expressed in
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates something, such as an instrument or index, to the currency its value is typically expressed in

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: holds shares in
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the issuer in which a shareholder holds an equity position

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is denominated in
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the currency in which the financial instrument was issued

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is legally recorded in
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: jurisdiction (country, county, state, province, city) in which the financial instrument is legally recorded for regulatory and/or tax purposes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has closing price determination method
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a strategy by which the official closing price is determined

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has price determination method
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a strategy by which a given price is determined

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has pricing source
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the origin of a given quote or price for a financial instrument

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has rate of return
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the retrospective rate of return for a given financial instrument over some period of time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has trading date time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the specific date and time associated with a given price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has settlement method
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the strategy for settlement from a delivery perspective

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has preferred settlement currency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the preferred currency for settlement purposes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has settlement amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the monetary amount required for cash settlement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has entity expiration reason
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the reason that an entity ceased to exist (i.e., disolved, merged with another entity, etc.)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has entity status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the status of the entity (i.e., active, inactive)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has managing local operating unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a legal entity identification record to the identifier for the local operating unit that registered the relevant legal entity identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has registration status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the status of a specific registration, such as for an identifier or license

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has validation authority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies the business registration authority for the legal entity, used by the Local Operating Unit (LOU) as the basis for validation, as defined in the GLEIF Registration Authorities List

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has validation level
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the level of validation performed by the registrar with respect to the legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has date established
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the date that the financial service provider was formally established

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has date establishment terminated
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: last full day that the entity existed

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has date insured
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: date on which insurance became effective

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has portfolio company
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a party in which a venture capital firm, a buyout firm, or a holding company has invested

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is portfolio company of
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a venture capital firm, a buyout firm, or a holding company that is a financial sponsor (i.e. investor in) of the party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: regulates supply of
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a regulatory agency to something it controls or supervises the availability of in some market by means of rules and regulations

annotations.example: The Federal Reserve System, whose banks together comprise the central bank of the United States, supervises banking system and regulates the money supply in the US.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has market identifier code status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the status of a specific market identifier code (MIC)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: operates in country
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the ISO 3166-1 country in which an exchange, data reporting services provider, or crypto asset services provider operates

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: operates in municipality
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the municipality or business center in which in which an exchange, data reporting services provider, or crypto asset services provider operates

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has home country
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates, with respect to a foreign bank, the country in which the foreign bank is chartered or incorporated

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has home country supervisor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates, with respect to a foreign bank, the governmental entity or entities in the foreign bank's home country with responsibility for the supervision and regulation of the foreign bank

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has primary federal regulator
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies the primary federal regulator for an institution

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has secondary federal regulator
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies an additional federal regulator, over and above the primary federal regulator, for an institution

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: applies to account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the account to which the transaction record or individual transaction applies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has balance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates an account to the net amount of money available in that account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has close date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates something to the date that it was closed

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has corresponding account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a credit agreement to an account used as the basis for managing transactions

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has ending balance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates an account statement to the amount of money available in that account at the end of the statement period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has open date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates something to the date that it was created

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has payment due date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date by which payment of some amount must be made to the creditor

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has posting date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date that the transaction was posted to the account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has primary account holder
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates an account to a client or customer that is considered the primary owner of the account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has secondary account holder
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates an account to a client or customer that is considered a secondary, co-owner of the account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has starting balance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates an account statement to the amount of money available in that account at the beginning of the statement period

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has transaction date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which the transaction actually occurred

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: involves merchant
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the merchant (seller) involved in the transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is linked to account
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: connects a given customer account to another customer account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: records transaction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links an account statement to the individual transactions it documents

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exposes in
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the state of affairs in which exposure occurs

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: facilitates
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: acts as an enabler in a situation in which an event, a task, a conversation or something else occurs

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has exposed party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the party subject to influence or risk in

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has exposure to
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: involves influence or risk from

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has generating entity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a legal entity that generates something

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has generating entity identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies an identifier for the entity that generated a unique transaction identifier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has registered agent
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies a party as one that has the legal, medical or financial capacity to act on behalf of someone else under specific circumstances

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has offering
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates something to a voluntary but conditional promise submitted by a buyer or seller (offeror) to another (offeree) for acceptance, and which becomes legally enforceable if accepted by the offeree

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has offering amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the notional monetary amount, determined based on reference data, market rates or some other agreed method associated with some offering

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has offering price
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the price associated with an offering, which may be an explicit or calculated price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has selecting party
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the person(s) or organization(s) responsible for determining the contents of a basket

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has settlement date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date by which an executed order or transaction must be settled

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has trade date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which a security or other instrument-specific trade actually takes place

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is embodied in
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies the representation or tangible form of something in some context

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is exposed party in
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the state of affairs in which the party bears the risk

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is exposed to
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: is subject to influence or risk from

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is exposure of
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: is the influence or risk borne by

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is facilitated by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies someone or something that expedites some event, transaction, conversation or something else in some context

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is offering of
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates an offering to one or things that are the subject of the offer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: relates to
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: has a logical or causal connection with

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has source of funds
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: refers to the origin of some amount of money

annotations.example: Typical sources include accounts, payments, etc.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has target of funds
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: refers to the sink for some amount of money

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has base currency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a unit of currency representing R units of the dealt currency, where R is the exchange rate value, in an exchange rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has currency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the medium of exchange value in which something, such as a monetary amount is denominated

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has dealt currency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a unit of currency representing the exchanged (target) currency in an exchange rate; R units of this currency represent one unit of the base currency

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has monetary amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a value for something in terms of an amount of money and the currency in which it is denoted

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has notional amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: has a generally unchangeable value used for certain calculations, expressed as some monetary amount

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has price
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the value of something expressed as an amount of money or goods

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is price for
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a price to something it provides a value for

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has age of majority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates someone to the age required to attain the capacity to engage in certain transactions or be treated legally as an adult in some jurisdiction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has citizenship
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a person to their country of citizenship

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies an asset that an owner owns

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is owned and controlled by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates something to the party that owns, influences, manages and directs it

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: owns and controls
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: directs and exercises authoritative or dominating influence over some thing that is also owned

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has mailing address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies a physical address where an independent party can receive communications, including letters and packages

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: holds
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: is the relationship between a party and something it possesses, or over which it exercises some ownership or control or has at its discretion the ability to dispose of it as it sees fit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is held by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the party that possesses and has at least partial control of something, regardless of ownership

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a means by which something (in the case of a network address) or some entity may be located or contacted or may receive correspondence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has individual postcode
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the local or international postcode element of a delivery address as specified by the local postal service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has postdirectional symbol
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a geographic directional symbol that follows the street name and street suffix in a street address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has predirectional symbol
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a geographic directional symbol that occurs after the primary street number but before the street name in a street address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has primary address number
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a a location with respect to a given street

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has secondary unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies an individual unit within a larger structure, such as an apartment, office, hangar, slip, mailbox, and so forth, at a given street address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has street address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a fully-specified address component that consists of a primary address number, predirectional, street name, suffix, postdirectional, and an optional secondary unit

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has street name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies an identifier for a street in some context (e.g., 'Baker', 'First', 'Main')

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has street suffix
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies an additional qualifier for a street or other delivery location, such as a dwelling located along a waterway

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has structure name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies an identifier for a building, house, office complex, shopping center, or other structure or group of structures

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has transliterated address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies a transliterated (i.e., in Latin or Romanized ASCII) address for the registered entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has urbanization
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates area, sector, or development within a geographic area relevant to a delivery address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has electronic mail address
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies an electronic messaging endpoint at which some entity may be located or contacted or may receive correspondence

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has telephone number
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a virtual address composed of a sequence of digits and symbols that may be assigned to a fixed-line telephone subscriber station, a wireless electronic telephony device, such as a radio telephone or a mobile telephone, or other similar device or service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fulfills obligation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: satisfies a requirement for payment of some claim, debt, or other obligation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has payment amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the amount of money involved in a payment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has payment schedule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the schedule for fulfillment of an obligation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: buys
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a party in the role of purchaser to something that they have purchased or plan to purchase

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: buys from
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a party in the role of purchaser to a party from which they have made or are planning to make a purchase

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has buyer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the purchasing party in the context of a sales transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has seller
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the vendor in the context of a sales transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is provisioned by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies the service provider that provisions the service or facility

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is supplied by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies the party (supplier, vendor, distributor, etc.) that makes a product available

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: provisions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: customizes, provides, or outfits something required for use in delivering a service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sells
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a party in the role of broker, dealer, vendor, or merchandiser to something that they make available for sale

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sells to
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a party in the role of broker, dealer, vendor, or merchandiser to a purchaser or potential purchasing party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: supplies
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a party in the role of outfitter, provisioner, distributor, etc. to something that they provide

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: causes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relationship between an event or set of events or factors (the cause) and a second event, phenomenon, situation, or result (the effect), where the second event or outcome is understood as a consequence of the first

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: confers
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: grants or bestows by virtue of some authority

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: embodies
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: is an expression of, gives a tangible or visible form to (an idea, quality, or feeling), makes concrete and perceptible

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: evaluates
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: assesses the nature, quality, or ability of someone or something

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exchanges
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: gives something in return something else

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: exemplifies
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: is a concrete realization or example of

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: generates
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: produces through the application of one or more mathematical or logical steps or rules

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: involves
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: (of a situation or event) includes (something) as a necessary part or result

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is caused by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: is the relationship between an event (the effect) and a second event (the cause), where the first event is understood as a consequence of the second; also, the relationship between a set of factors (causes) and a phenomenon (the effect)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is conferred by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a relationship between a right or obligation and the vehicle, such as an agreement or contract, that vests (or confers) said right or obligation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is evaluated by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: is ascertained or determined by

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is exemplified by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: is made concrete or is realized by

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is generated by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies some party or something that produces something via some equation, logic, or rules

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is issued by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a functional entity or party responsible for circulating, distributing, or publishing something

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is mandated by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a responsibility, capacity, or action to that which requires it

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is produced by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies the producer that fabricates, manufactures or otherwise creates something through some production process

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: issues
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: officially makes something available

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mandates
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates something to a commitment, contract, law, obligation, requirement, regulation, or similar concept that requires it

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: produces
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: creates through a fabrication, manufacturing or production process

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is imbalance in
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The imbalance in Obligations or Rights (depending on the viewpoint from which it is described) between one party and another.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sets out contractual economic commitment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The economic commitment set out in the terms to the contract which formalizes the agreement to the transaction.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: takes material form
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The material form of the Economic Resource; that is the thing which is recognized as being an Economic Resource as defined here, Editorial Note: This would usually be some Independent Thing. However it is conceivable that the existence of some relative thing, for example an asset, may itself be regarded and defined as a resource, over and above the role or context already defined for it. Therefore this identity relationship has a range of Thing, but is modeled as a sub property of "identity" to make this conclusion explicit. Editorial Note: This is a relationship with the sense that some relative thing takes the form of something, but is distinct from the similar concept as applied to Asset, in which the thing which takes the form of some asset is owned by someone. Here it is a resource, irrespective of whether or by whom it is owned. Labeled as "takes material form" to disambiguate these two relationships.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has fixed comparative date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the a specific date, such as the end of the last recession (e.g., March 2009) against which the scoped measure is compared

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has formula
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a concise way of expressing information symbolically, as in a mathematical or chemical formula

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has minuend
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the quantity value from which something is subtracted; the value that is diminished

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has observed value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a collection of values over which some analysis is performed

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has periodicity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a recurrence interval (monthly, quarterly, annual) that a statistical measure reflects

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has reference period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a reference (baseline) recurrence interval for which a given measure applies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has relative comparative date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a date against which the value of a scoped measure is compared (e.g., one month prior, three months prior, etc., and typically against a prior release or average over prior releases)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has relative comparative period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a period (typically a prior period) against which the scoped measure is compared, such as an average set of values for some period of time compared with a more recent or projected average for a forward looking period of time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has release date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the date on which something is published

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has subtrahend
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the quantity value that is subtracted from something

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has target value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a collection of values that represent planned or projected goals or objectives for some something over time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has baseline population
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the starting point statistical universe or population used for comparison or analysis

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has comparison population
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the subset of the baseline statistical universe or population used for comparison or analysis

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has duration of unemployment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the length of time, typically in weeks, that people classified as unemployed have been continuously looking for work

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has indicator value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a quantity value for a given indicator

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has series origin
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the original starting date for the time series for a given economic indicator

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has exchange rate quotation source
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the origin of a quoted exchange rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has quotation block amount basis
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the amount of the dealt currency which would be exchanged in a trade for which the stated spot rate applies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has quotation settlement basis
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the settlement period for a trade for which the stated spot rate applies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has quote currency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the quote currency in an exchange rate; R units of this currency represent one unit of the base currency

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has quoted exchange rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rate of exchange between two currencies as specified as of some date and time as quoted by a specific source

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is premium on
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an exchange rate expressed as a premium on the spot rate for the currency pair

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has quotation date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the quotation date for a given market rate or indicator

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is volatility of
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates something to which the volatility measure applies and of which it is a measure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has rate reset time of day
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the time of day when a change in a benchmark rate is published, typically the same time every business day

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has reference currency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates something to the currency it is based on

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has tenor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the length of time for which a given rate, such as an interbank rate, exchange rate, other market rate is quoted, or a debt instrument has remaining prior to maturity or expiration

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has market capitalization
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the market capitalization of some issuer as of some date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has market capitalization value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the monetary amount representing the market capitalization of some issuer as of some date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has original notional value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the notional amount represented by the index when it is first constituted

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has premium
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a premium payable for a contract based on the index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has up front fee
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a fee payable by any party that wishes to participate in a contract based on the index after the start of its life

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has application date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: date on which an application was signed and submitted

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has application phase
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The phase within the application lifecycle, that this Loan Application is at,

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has approved amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates something, e.g. a loan, to the amount of funds approved

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has gross income
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the personal gross income of the borrower

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has requested amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates something, e.g. a request for a loan, to the amount of funds requested

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: uses factor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates e.g. a risk assessment to something used as a factor to make the assessment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has default amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: amount before the application of sale proceeds and recoveries

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has judgement amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Undefined PoC SDM Notes: Total value of CCJs or equivalent recorded against the primary borrower that were satisfied / unsatsified (at time of underwriting ) is computed by selecting the satisfaction code value of interest and aggregating against all borrower CC Judgements </p>

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has cost
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: has amount payable for principal, interest, fees or other expenses

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has first rate change term
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a period of time in months after origination during which the interest rate cannot change

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has individual payment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links an actual payment of principal, interest, and other related amounts to the overall payment history for an account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has loan balance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the balance with respect to the principal on the loan as of some date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has payment history
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a credit agreement, loan, or commitment to any history of payments that have been made by the borrower up to the point that payment history is requested

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has pre-payment penalty term
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a loan to a period of time in months after which there is no prepayment penalty

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has principal amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the nominal amount of the loan that must be paid at or before maturity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has scheduled unpaid balance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates what the balance should be after a scheduled payment is made according to contract terms

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has total closing costs
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the total the amount paid at the closing of a real estate transaction, i.e., at the time when the title to the property is conveyed (transferred) to the buyer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has total points and fees
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a form of pre-paid interest, charged by the lender as an alternative to charging a higher rate of interest on the mortgage loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is performed by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a loan to the financial service provider that services it

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has card verification code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a credit card to either: (1) magnetic-stripe data, or (2) printed security features that are used to protect data integrity and limit alteration, counterfeiting and fraud generally

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has credit card network
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the underlying network for credit card product

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has primary account number
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the account number displayed on the face of the card

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: uses currency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the currency defined for the credit card product

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has assessment boundary
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the scope, limits, and context for an environmental or sustainability project

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has spatial boundary
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a geographic region included in an environmental or sustainability assessment, which may cover a specific site, facility, region, or the global operations of a company or project

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has unit cost
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates an item to its unit cost

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: percentage advanced
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The percentage of the purchase price advanced as the loan.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has maximum allowed balance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: maximum balance that may be outstanding at any time, below the credit limit, for loans with flexible re-draw facilities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has maximum anticipated balance
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: maximum balance the borrower believes they might need, below the credit limit, for planning purposes, for loans with flexible re-draw facilities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has milestone maximum drawdown amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: maximum amount of the loan that can be drawn by the borrower on completion of the milestone

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: HMDA disposition date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the date associated with the HMDA Disposition for a HMDA Covered Loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: assumes
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a new mortgage loan contract to a previous one made to a different borrower for the same property. The new contract is created via a legally binding process where the new borrower assumes the terms of the previous loan contract

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has originating service provider
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates something, typically a loan contract, to the service provider responsible for originated the loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has originator person
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates something, typically a loan, to a person that initially originates or creates it

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has initial funding date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a mortgage to the date on which the contract is consummated, officially creating the obligations therein

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: determination period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: THe period for which the performance is determined

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: performance determination timeframe
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The timeframe on which the performance is reported (e.g. 1month, 1 year, YTD).

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: equivalent life value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The Equivalent Life in years at the stated date.

has deal management style
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether the CDO is static or managed. This refers to whether or not the CDO manager may make changes to the reference portfolio during the life of the security. Further notes: If it is static, collateral is fixed through the life of the CDO. The reference assets are bought and then are kept untouched for the term of the product.If it is managed, the reference assets are bought (the portfolio is ramped up) and then the CDO manager may alter the portfolio as they see fit.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: seniority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The seniority which defines this tranche. This is the precedence order for scheduled payments. Further notes: Tranches are categorized as senior, mezzanine, and subordinated/equity, according to their degree of credit risk. If there are defaults or the CDO's collateral otherwise underperforms, scheduled payments to senior tranches take precedence over those of mezzanine tranches, and scheduled payments to mezzanine tranches take precedence over those to subordinated/equity tranches. Senior and mezzanine tranches are typically rated, with the former receiving ratings of A to AAA and the latter receiving ratings of B to BBB. The ratings reflect both the credit quality of underlying collateral as well as how much protection a given tranch is afforded by tranches that are subordinate to it.
