https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Frequency at which the subscriptions are done.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: subscription period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Specific period, eg, for some guaranteed funds, during which the units/shares may be subscribed to.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: subsequent application form
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Physical application form for subsequent investments by the same investor.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: switching fee
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Actual percentage or fixed amount of money due when switching to another fund. Definition origin:EFAMA DD

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tracking error
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: See RiskFactors narrative in EFAMA DD

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: valuation frequency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Frequency of the net asset value calculation.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: value at risk
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: See RiskClassification_NameOf in EFAMA DD Applies to Fund not Portfolio.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has legal structure
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the legal form that the fund takes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has sub-fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a pooled fund to a sub-fund that is a constituent of the parent fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is sub-fund of
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a pooled fund to a parent fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has actual closing date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which an offering or transaction officially closes, in contrast with an intended closing date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has announcement date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the first day the public will receive information regarding a new security issue

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has financial instrument short name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a security to its ISO 18774-compliant short name, which includes an issuer short name, abbreviated instrument characteristics, and abbreviated instrument description per the ISO standard

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has first trade date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which a newly issued security starts trading

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has first trade settlement date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which the first trade of a newly issued security is settled

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has subscription period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a period of time in which investors can commit to purchase shares (or units) to be issued

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is issued in form
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the form in which the security is issued, typically in registered form

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is registered
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the registration authority for a given security, i.e., in the name of the owner on the books of the issuer, with the issuer's registrar, with a third-party transfer agent, with a broker-dealer, or other competent party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is underwritten by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates an offering to an underwriter involved in raising capital for or distributing the instruments that are the subject of the offering

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: specifies conversion into
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a security that will replace a convertible security under the terms of the agreement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underwrites
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies one or more underwriters involved in raising capital for or distributing the instruments that are the subject of the offering

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has home exchange
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the exchange that is considered the primary market for a security; typically, but not always, in the country in which the security was originally issued

annotations.example: A security may have been originally listed on the Frankfurt exchange, but its current home is the London Stock Exchange, for example.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has last trading date and time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the last date and time that the security was traded on the exchange

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has original place of listing
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the original exchange that listed the security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has tick size
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a minimum price movement for the security with respect to an exchange

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is listed via
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies the service responsible for listing the security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is traded on
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies the trading facility on which the security is traded

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lists
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a given exchange-specific security listing to its issue

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has holding period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies a holding period applicable to some financial asset

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has restriction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies a restriction applicable to a given financial instrument or listing

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has option sequence number
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the order of occurance of an optional element in an enumerated list

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has parameter mapping
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: maps a quantitative or qualitative parameter defined in the ACTUS data dictionary with something else, such as a property specified in FIBO

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has parameter name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: associates a name with a quantitative or qualitative factor defined in the ACTUS data dictionary used as a condition for classification of one or more contract type

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has coverage description
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: describes the contracts that the classifier applies to

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has merchant category description
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: provides a text description of the sector to which the code applies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has shares authorized
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the maximum number of shares that are permitted to be issued, as established by the board of directors

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has legal form abbreviation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the precise abbreviation for the entity legal form as defined in the jurisdiction in which it is registered, for example LLC, LLP, Ltd, PLC, Corp.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has ownership percentage
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the percentage ownership interest in the owned entity owned by owning entity, if known

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has transliterated legal form abbreviation
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a transliterated (i.e., in Latin or Romanized ASCII) representation of the abbreviation for the entity legal form

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has transliterated name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a transliterated (i.e., in Latin or Romanized ASCII) representation of a name for the entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is quantified by
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates that something is limited to or conditional due to some rate or other statistical value

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: consists of number of units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the number of units of

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is bank qualified
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: designation given to a public purpose bond offering by the issuer if it reasonably expects to issue in the calendar year of such offering no more than $10 million par amount of bonds of the type required to be included in making such calculation under the Internal Revenue Code. When purchased by a commercial bank for its portfolio, the bank may receive an 80% tax deduction for the interest cost of carry for the issue. A bond that is bank qualified is also known as a qualified tax-exempt obligation.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: issue nominal number of units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Total original quantity of securities issued.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: issue offering units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Quantity of all securities that is offered in an equity or Corporate Bond issue.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: minimum issue subscription
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Minimum or incremental denomination required for the transfer or change of ownership of a security.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: series
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Uniquely identified collection of securities within an Issue with same Expected Closing Date. The text gives the Series Identifier within the Issuance process. There may be one or more Series within one Issue.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: over alloted
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether the subscriber has been over-alloted the requested number of units. REVIEW: Not seen in data terms but implied elsewhere.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: series
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Series identification for the individual Traded Financial Security.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: subscription amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Number of units of the issue that an individual subscriber is allocated.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: underwriter takedown shares
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Takedown quantity of the security handled by the underwriter (that will be brought into DTC).

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: announcement comments
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Free form description of Purpose of Issue, Source of funds etc.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: maximum over allotment shares
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The maximum amount of shares that are available as part of providing the over-allotment option.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: over allotment available
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether an over-allotment option is available for the security.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: over allotment expiry period days
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Number of calendar days after the closing of initial offering for expiry of over-allotment option.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: sale method
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Sale Method of the security.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: allows substitution
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether it is possible to substitute other obligations in place of the specified deliverable obligation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has monitoring frequency
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: has frequency with respect to how often, in days, the asset price is checked to see if the barrier has been breached

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is above strike price
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the barrier is crossed when the price of the underlier is above (or below, if not) the strike price (threshold)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: uses weighted average
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether a weighted average is being used to calculate the average rate or strike price

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has conversion factor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the price of the delivered bond/note ($1 par value) to yield a fixed rate. The conversion factor is used to calculate a final delivery price.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has multiple
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the multiple for determining the price of the futures contract in relation to the underlying index rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has conversion ratio
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the factor used to determine the number of warrants needed in order to buy or sell a specific number of securities or investment units

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has oversubscribe option
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the holders of the rights instrument may get securities in the event that other right holders choose not to subscribe

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has floating rate spread
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: defines the spread rate that can optionally be used to adjust the floating rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has rate multiplier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a multiplier applied to the coupon before adding the floating rate spread

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: involves multiple events
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates that the restructuring spans more than one credit event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is default interest applicable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether a party that defaults in the performance of any payment obligation is, to the extent permitted by law and the applicable agreement, required to pay interest (before as well as after judgment) on the overdue amount to the other party on demand in the same currency as such overdue amount, for the period from (and including) the original due date for payment to (but excluding) the date of actual payment

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is grace period extendable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether or not the grace period may be extended, which may be jurisdiction specific

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has anticipated number of payments
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the number of payments promised per the terms of the contract over the lifetime of the contract assuming all payments are made

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is negotiable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies whether a particular financial instrument is or is not transferable

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has book depth
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates depth of the order book to which the price refers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has lot size
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: magnitude of an item (i.e., total quantity)

annotations.example: For example, with respect to corn, 5000 bushels is a typical contract size. For some oil commodities trades, 1000 barrels is considered a single contract. For equity options, the lot size is typically 100 shares of the underlying.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has number of days accrued
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the number of days for which interest has accrued and has not yet been received

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has quote lot size
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: magnitude of something to which the quote price refers

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has round lot size
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: standard number of securities traded on an exchange

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has trading volume
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the number of shares/units traded on a given trading day

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is fractional eligible
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the security can contain fractional share/amounts

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is fully automated securities transfer applicable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the security is to be held at the transfer agent as part of the FAST (Fully Automated Securities Transfer) program

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has alternative language legal name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: denotes a registered legal name for the entity in an alternative language used in the legal jurisdiction in which the entity is registered

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has automatically transliterated legal name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: denotes an auto-generated ASCII-transliterated representation of the legal name for the entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has entity expiration date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which an entity ceases(d) to exist

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has expiry date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which something ceases(d) to exist

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has initial registration date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which an identifier or other registered item was created and/or first registered

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has preferred transliterated legal name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: denotes a preferred ASCII-transliterated representation of the legal name for the entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has prior legal name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: denotes a primary legal name that was used previously for the entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has registration status revision date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date that the status of a specific registration in the registry was revised

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has registry name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: denotes a name for the registry, for example, for a business registry in which a business registration identifier for the legal entity is registered

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has renewal date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date by which a specific registration in the registry must be renewed or updated

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has trading or operational name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: denotes a 'trading as', 'brand name', 'doing business as', or 'operating under' name currently used by the entity in addition to, but not replacing, the (primary) legal, official registered name

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has transliterated legal name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: denotes an optional ASCII-transliterated (i.e. Latin- or Romanized) representation of the legal name for the entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has validation date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date that a specific registration in the registry was most recently reviewed and validated

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is self-maintained
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the information about the entity is maintained internally or by a third-party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has facility acronym
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a known acronym of the market

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is subject to reserve requirements
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether some capability of a financial service provider is contingent on conformance with certain Federal Reserve policies, regulations, or other requirements

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has transaction description
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: provides a textual description of the transaction

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has transaction record status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the status of the transaction record

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has nominal number of units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the base number of units of something associated with some offering

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has offering units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the actual number of units of something, including any premium on the number of units, associated with some offering

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has selection criteria
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: describes the methodology or program used to determine the membership of a collection

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: total number or quantity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has funds type
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the type of funds, such as next day for US funds

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has minor unit
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a code for the minor unit of currency to the currency or fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has numeric code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a numeric code to something, such as a currency or fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has rate value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: has a value for a rate expressed as a number (may be a percentage or raw number)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has family name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the name shared in common to identify the members of a family, as distinguished from each member's given name

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has first name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the given name or first name of a person, that is, the name chosen for them at birth or changed by them subsequently from the name given at birth

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has full legal name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the complete name of a person, typically used in formal situations including those of a legal or contractual nature

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has gender
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a particular gender value with a person

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has given name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the given name or first name of a person, that is, the name chosen for them at birth or changed by them subsequently from the name given at birth

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has last name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the name shared in common to identify the members of a family, as distinguished from each member's given name

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has maiden name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the name shared in common to identify the members of a family, that predates any changes of name due to marriage

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has middle name or initial
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: one or more additional names or initial letters for names that occur between a person's first and last name

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has name prefix
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a character or sequence of characters, preceding a person's name, that provides additional information about the person, such as a form of address representing a title, honorific, or military rank

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has name suffix
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a character or sequence of characters, following a person's name, that provides additional information about the person, such as their position, educational degree, accreditation, office, or honor

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has person name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links a name to an individual

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has surname
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the name shared in common to identify the members of a family, as distinguished from each member's given name

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has legal description
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: provides the text, or a summary thereof, expressed in legal terms, of the contract provision, clause, or other element

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is assignable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the contract and the rights thereunder may be assigned by one of the signatories to some other party

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is netting automatic
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether netting takes place automatically under the scope of the agreement

annotations.example: Example text: "If on any date amounts would otherwise be payable:- (i) in the same currency; and (ii) in respect of the same Transaction, by each party to the other, then, on such date, each party's obligation to make payment of any such amount will be automatically satisfied and discharged and, if the aggregate amount that would otherwise have been payable by one party exceeds the aggregate amount that would otherwise have been payable by the other party, replaced by an obligation upon the party by whom the larger aggregate amount would have been payable to pay to the other party the excess of the larger aggregate amount over the smaller aggregate amount."

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has collection size
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the number of elements in a given collection

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has assignment termination date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the date on which an identifier is released from its assignment to some resource

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has initial assignment date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the date on which an identifier is first assigned to some resource

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has measure within scale
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a relative, numeric measure or ordering on a rating scale

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has worst measure
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the 'worst' (least desirable) possible value for a rating score's hasMeasureWithinScale property

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has acquisition date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: links an asset or owner/controller/controllee to the date or date and time of purchase

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has closing date time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the day and time at which something closes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has count
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the total number of things in a collection, such as the number of entries in a regular schedule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has date specification
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: rule that specifies how a specified date is computed

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has opening date time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the day and time at which something opens

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has ordinal number
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a number designating place in an ordered sequence, i.e., 1st, 2nd, 3rd, etc.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has relative duration
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: duration between two explicit dates

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has event date value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: identifies a date or date and time value associated with an event (occurrence)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has fractional interest
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: has proportionate, non-exclusive entitlement to

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is initially controlled on
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date or date and time that some level of authority or influence was first put in place

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has address line 1
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the first line of the street address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has address line 2
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the second line of the street address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has address line 3
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the third line of the street address

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has attention line
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an optional, free text address line denoting the intended recipient

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has mail routing
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an optional, free text address line containing explicit routing information (this elements's presence indicates that this address is a routing / 'care of' address)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has postal code
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the postal code of this address as specified by the local postal service

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: requires secondary unit range
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: if true, indicates that an additional qualifier is needed to complete the delivery point description, such as an apartment number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has alias
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates an alternate name of by which something is known

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has common name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a name by which something is frequently referred, without reference to any formal usage or structure

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has formal name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a name by which something is known for some official purpose or context, or which is structured in some way such as to always follow the same format regardless of usage

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has legal name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the name used to refer to a party in legal communications

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: was formerly known as
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a name by which something was known in the past

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: offset for w i issue date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Used to calculate actual settlement date from given WI issue date. If issue date is unknwn, this determines how many days form the issue date it's going to settle.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has measurement date time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date and time that the measurement was taken

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has measurement period in months
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the coverage period for which the measure is applicable expressed in months

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has number of entries
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the number of elements in some document, table, or other resource (e.g., in a report, table)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has population size
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the number of elements in a given population

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has release date and time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the date and time on which something is published

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has universe size
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the number of elements in a given universe

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has weight
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates an amount given to increase or decrease the importance of an item

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is calculated via methodology
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: high-level description of the approach taken to obtain the result

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is estimate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the measure reflects an estimate (approximation) or not

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: excludes energy and food
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the calculation of the index includes energy and food prices or not

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is seasonally adjusted
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a predicate indicating whether some published formal method is applied that compensates for seasonal variations in the population or index value

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has quotation date and time
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a quotation date and possibly a time for a given market rate, interest rate, indicator, or other quoted pricing information

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has debt ranking
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the ranking of this debt instrument with respect to the credit index as a whole

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has index name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies a formal name for the index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has index value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the value of a given index as of the release date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has spread range
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the range of credit spread for the constituents of the index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has intended loan purpose
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the purpose to which the loaned funds are to be put

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has original loan debt-to-income ratio
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the debt-to-income (DTI) ratio at the time when the loan was advanced; for combined income

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is pre-approval requested
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether a pre-approval has been requested, in conjunction with a loan application

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: in default
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether the loan is in default.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has balloon payment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the contractual terms include or would have included repayment of the outstanding principal sum at the end of a loan period, prior to which only partial or no payments were made on the principal

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has negative amortization
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the contractual terms include or would have included a feature that allows unpaid interest to be added to the balance of unpaid principal

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is assumable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether or not another borrower may assume the payments on this loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is initially payable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the obligation arising from the covered loan was, or in the case of an application, would have been initially payable to the financial institution

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is interest only
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the contractual terms include or would have included interest only payments

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has business purpose description
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: provides a description of the purpose of the loan from the perspective of the borrower

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: boat held as chattel
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether the vessel is to be held in ownership as a form of chattel by the lender during the period of the loan.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: moored at
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Textual description (name etc.) of where the vessel is to be moored if it has a permanent mooring place.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: residential
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether the boat is intended to be used and is legally able to be used as a place of residence.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has number of affordable dwelling units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates real estate to the number of dwelling units it contains that are income-restricted under Federal, State, or local affordable housing programs.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has number of dwelling units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates real estate to the number of dwelling units it contains

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is ARM convertible
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether or not the loan can be converted into an adjustable-rate mortgage contract (ARM)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: decimal places
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The number of decimal places used in the publication of the factor value.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is compounded
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Definition needed Moved from Yield - assume this can only be about debt instrument or loan / debt yields i..e where the income relates to interest payments. .

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: price is traded
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The highest valuation over the period specified. Notes from Equity review, may apply to Debt also: this can be regarded as a derived price. See also note in LowPrice Difference: different rules used. May be based on trade OR quote price Analytic or Price?? this is a derived type but with a much simpler rule.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: price quoted ex dividend
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether or not the yield is based on a price which is quoted ex-dividend. When a bond is said to trade ex-dividend it means that there is a period of time prior to each coupon payment during which a bond purchaser does not receive custody of the next coupon. That payment is made to the previous bond holder and accrued interest is therefore negative during the ex-dividend period.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: quoted ex dividend
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether or not the price is quoted ex-dividend. When a bond is said to trade ex-dividend it means that there is a period of time prior to each coupon payment during which a bond purchaser does not receive custody of the next coupon. That payment is made to the previous bond holder and accrued interest is therefore negative during the ex-dividend period.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rounding convention
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The rounding convention used in the calculation method.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has ceiling
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the maximum variable interest payment amount

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has floor
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the minimum variable interest payment amount

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is bank qualified
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether or not a given municipal bond conforms with section 265(b)(3) of the IRS tax code; when purchased by a commercial bank for its portfolio, such designation allows the bank to deduct a portion of the interest cost of carry for the position

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is legal opinion available
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether a legal opinion exists for a given municipal bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is mandatory
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether something is required

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is pro-rated
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the coupon is pro rated to the actual number of days in the payment period versus the number of payment periods

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: super sinker
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates that the bond has a long-term coupon but short potential short maturity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is cash
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether the CDO has an underlying pool of real assets. If yes, the CDO has an underlying pool of real assets. If no, the CDO has a synthetic pool of underlying assets.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is cash
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether the CDO has an underlying pool of real assets. This is yes: the CDO has an underlying pool of real assets,

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: seniority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The seniority which defines this tranche. This is the precedence order for scheduled payments. This is Mezzanine, meaning the tranche between senior and subordinated.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: seniority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The seniority which defines this tranche. This is the precedence order for scheduled payments. This is defined as Senior, i.e. this is the most senior tranche of the CDO issue.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: seniority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The seniority which defines this tranche. This is the precedence order for scheduled payments. This is subordinated (also known as equity) and is the most junior tranche in the CDO issue.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: seniority
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The seniority which defines this tranche. This is the precedence order for scheduled payments. This is defined as Senior, i.e. this is the most senior tranche of the CDO issue.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: allows auto-reinvestment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the security allows automatically re-investing the interest on that security towards purchasing additional shares or units of the same security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: allows payment in kind
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the principal may be repaid in kind (i.e., replaced with another instrument) rather than in cash

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has default lot size
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the default number of units of the security that may be held at any one time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has estate or death put feature
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates that a security is subject to redemption upon the passing of the holder

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has pool number
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the pool number of the debt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: right to retain
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the holder has an option to retain the security in the event of an issuer exercising the put feature

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is callable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the issuer (writer) of the debt contract (the debtor) can call the debt prior to maturity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is exchangeable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the security can be exchanged for another security at the issuers discretion

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is extendable by holder
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the expiration date or maturity date can be extended by the holder

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is extendable by issuer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the issuer has the option to extend the debt rather than refinancing

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is putable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the holder has the right to ask for redemption of the security prior to final maturity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is strippable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether or not the instrument can be stripped, so that interest and principal may be traded separately

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is subordinated
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the security is a subordinated security, meaning that the security has a lower priority than another security so that when the assets are liquidated this one is not first in line

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: prime
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether the mortage pool is identified as Prime or not.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is pass through
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the cash flows from the underlying asset pool are passed through to the investor by way of redemption payments

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is cash
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether the CDO has an underlying pool of real assets. This is No: the CDO has a synthetic pool of underlying assets.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has multiplier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the number of underlying shares (whether multiple or fractional) represented by a single depositary receipt

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has number of depositary receipts issued
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the number of receipts issued to the general public

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: number of votes per share
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: grants the right to vote on a per share basis to the shareholder

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has available shares
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the number of shares outstanding less those shares that are restricted, i.e., those that are available for trading

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has extendable maturity date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the issuer and/or holders of redeemable shares with a fixed maturity date have the option to extend the maturity date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has extendable redemption date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the issuer and/or holders of redeemable shares with a specified redemption date have the option to extend that date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has floating stock
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the number of shares that are available for trading, i.e., the number of shares outstanding less closely held shares (those held by insiders) and restricted shares

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has share class
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the class to which the share belongs, typically differentiated by privileges, such as voting rights

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has shares issued
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the actual number of shares held by shareholders (i.e., shares outstanding) and treasury shares

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has shares outstanding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the number of shares currently held by shareholders, including those held by retail investors, institutional investors and insiders, and typically available for trading

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has treasury shares
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the number of shares issued but not outstanding, including those that were available in the market at one time but have been repurchased by the company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has voting restriction
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies restrictions on voting rights, if any

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is redeemable at issuer option
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the issuer has the option of initiating the buy-back, similar to a call feature

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is redeemable at shareholder option
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the shareholder has the option of initiating the buy-back, similar to a put feature

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: additional restrictions
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Other restrictions or treatment information in respect of this strategy and the organization to which it refers.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: back end load applicable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether an exit charge, eg, CDSC, on redemption orders for this class can be applied.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: blacklisted
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether or not the strategy in framed so as to include the referenced business entity as being blacklisted. If yes, the strategy prevents investment in securities issued by that organization.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: clear funds required
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether cleared funds may be required before a subscription order can be executed.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: dealing frequency description
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Description of frequency at which the subscriptions and redemptions are done.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: declaration channel
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Means of the net asset value publication, eg, a newspaper.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: distribution with reinvestment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: It is possible to hold shares for which the accrued income is distributed, but then reinvested automatically in additional units/shares allocated to the investor.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: dual fund
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether the fund has two prices.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: first accounting year end date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Last day of the first accounting year for the fund.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: first n a v calculation date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The first date of NAV calculation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: front end load applicable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether a front end charge on subscription orders for this class can be applied.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fund class type identifier
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: A textual identification of the class of fund units. This is used to uniquely identify a particular class of fund units, and thereby identify features of this type of unit within the fund.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: historic pricing indicator
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Indicates whether the price is historic or forward.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: holder may reinvest
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether or not the holder may reinvest dividends in the fund.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: holding transferable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether registered investors are able to transfer some or all of their holdings to third parties.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: include related firms
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether or not the strategy includes firms which are related in some way to the referenced organization.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: inclusion
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether the referred strategy is included. No means this description refers to the exclusion of what is described, from the portfolio.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: investment focus
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The information about the area the fund is mostly invested into (for example stock market in Germany).

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: launch date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Date of first NAV calculation and start of performance calculations

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: limited shares are issued
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether or not new shares can be issued in the fund. This is what makes it a closed end or open end fund.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: main fund order desk
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether the fund order desk is the principal entity appointed by the fund to which orders should be submitted.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: maximum redemption units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Maximum number of shares/units that may be redeemed on a single dealing day.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: minimum initial subscription units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Minimum initial number of units/shares that must be purchased.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: minimum remaining holding units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Minimum number of units/shares that must be retained to avoid automatic redemption.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: minimum subscription units
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Minimum number of units/shares that must be purchased by existing investors.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Name of the investment fund.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Name given to the defined strategy.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: physical document required
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether a phsyical form is required through the main fund order desk. Yes: A phsyical form is required through the main fund order desk. No: A phsyical form is not required through the main fund order desk.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: product group description
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Company specific description of a group of funds.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: redemption cycle in business days
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The last business day following the day on which a redemption order is priced (T) by which settlement will be due for orders placed with the main Fund Order Desk. Alternatively, if proceeds will be paid following receipt of written renunciation, the last business day following receipt of the relevant renunciation documentation by the main Fund Order Desk (R) by which the proceeds will be sent.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: redemption in amount allowed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether redemptions in amount are allowed.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: registration date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The date at which the fund is legally approved in a country other than the country of origin.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: signature required
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether a phsyical form with the investor's written signature is required through the main fund order desk. Yes:A phsyical form with the investor's written signature is required through the main fund order desk.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: stated investment aim
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The stated aim of the Fund in words, e.g outperfom a given benchmark.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: stated objective
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The stated objective of the fund, in words.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: subscriptions in amount allowed
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether subscriptions in amount are allowed.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: switching chargeable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Whether a switching charge for changing between sub-funds of the same umbrella can be applied.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: type of securities
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The type of securities or other holdings that may be invested in.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: valuation frequency textual description
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Description of the frequency of the net asset value calculation.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is open ended
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the fund is an open-end/closed-end fund

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is private
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates that the fund does not offer its securities to the general public

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has upper limit on floating shares
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the upper limit on the number of free float shares to be reported, if applicable

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is MiFID reporting required
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether reporting on the security is required by the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MiFID)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is Employee Retirement Income Security Act conformant
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the security conforms to the Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) of 1974, a federal outline for regulating employee benefit plans, including healthcare plans sponsored and/or insured by an employer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation insured
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether the security is covered by Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is subject to Federal Reserve Board Regulation T
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether a given cash or margin account is subject to Federal Reserve Board (FRB) margin requirements

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has instrument description
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a financial instrument or FISN to an ISO 18774-compliant instrument description, that is, a collection of characteristics and attributes defining a financial instrument with a maximum length up to 19 alphanumeric characters

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has issuer short name
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: relates a security issuer or FISN to an ISO 18774-compliant issuer short name, that is, an abbreviation of the official issuer name, limited to a maximum of 15 alphanumeric characters

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has series
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the series identified by the issuer in the event that the instrument is issued in several series (also known as tranches)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has subscription amount
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates a number of shares or units

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is over-allotted
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates whether or not the subscription is over-subscribed

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has delisting date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: specifies the date set by the exchange for delisting a security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: has listing date
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates the date on which a security is listed

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: is seasoned
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: indicates that the security has been publicly traded long enough to eliminate any short-term volume volatility from its initial public offering

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - annuity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to contracts whose principal is paid fully at the initial exchange date and principal plus interest is repaid periodically in constant amounts until maturity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - bond with warrant
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to bonds with attached warrants

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - boundary controlled switch
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to derivative contracts with subcontract legs which can be activated (knocked in) or extinguished (knocked out) when the underlying asset price reaches a specified value

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - call money
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to loans that are rolled over as long as they are not called

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - cap floor option
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to interest rate options expressed with a maximum or minimum interest rate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - cash
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to cash or cash equivalent positions

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - collateral
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to relationships between collateral, an obligee and a debtor, covering the exposure from the debtor with the collateral

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - commodity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to movements of commodities such as oil, gas or even houses that can serve as underlyings of commodity futures, guarantees or simply asset positions

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - convertible note
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to bonds with a call or put option

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - credit default swap
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to contracts for which a payment is triggered if one or more of the underlying counterparties defaults

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - exotic annuity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to contracts whose principal is paid fully at the initial exchange date and principal plus interest payments may include step ups in principal and/or interest until maturity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - exotic linear amortizer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to contracts whose principal is typically, but not always, paid fully at the initial exchange date and where the principal is typically repaid in equal amounts until a step change or maturity, with interest payments decreasing accordingly until a step change in the interest amount

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - exotic negative amortizer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to negative amortizing contracts but allowing step ups in principal and interest

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - exotic option
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to exotic options

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - future
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to futures

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - guarantee
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to credit enhancements that create a relationship between a guarantor, an obligee and a debtor, moving the exposure from the debtor to the guarantor

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - linear amortizer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to contracts whose principal is paid fully at the initial exchange date and where the principal is repaid in equal amounts until maturity, with interest payments decreasing accordingly

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - negative amortizer
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to contracts whose principal is paid fully at the initial exchange date and principal plus interest is repaid periodically in constant amounts until maturity, however, when resetting the rate, the total payment (principal plus interest remains constant) thus the maturity changes

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - option
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that calculates straight option pay-off for any basic contract as underlying (PAM, ANN etc.) but also SWAPS, FXOUT, STK and COM

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - perpetual bond
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to bonds without any maturity date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - plain vanilla swap
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to swaps where the underlyings are always two identical PAM's however with one leg fixed and the other variable

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - principal at maturity
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to contracts whose principal is paid fully at the initial exchange date and repaid at maturity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - repurchase agreement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to contracts that control and manage the sale and repurchase of assets on the books

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - securitization credit risk
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to securitization contracts ranked according to credit default

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - securitization market risk
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to securitization contracts where all underlying contracts are treated equally

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - stock
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to equity instruments representing ownership in a company, that is bought at a certain amount (normally market price), that then follows an index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - swap
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to derivative contracts where two parties exchange contracts

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - total return swap
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to swaps in which one party makes payments based on a set rate, either fixed or variable, while the other party makes payments based on the return of an underlying asset, which includes both the income it generates and any capital gains

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS calendar code - Monday to Friday
ACTUS dictionary term group - contract identification
ACTUS dictionary term group - notional principal
ACTUS dictionary term group - rate reset
Algorithmic Contract Types data dictionary
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: system of alpha-numeric symbols, or combinations of symbols, that stand for the terms in the ACTUS data dictionary, a controlled vocabulary defining the parameters that may apply to any given contract type

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - credit linked note
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to securities with an embedded credit default swap, linking the credit risk of a reference entity to the note's performance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - foreign exchange outright
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to agreements where two parties agree to exchange fixed cash flows in different currencies at a specified future date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - margining
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to margin contracts that traces the value changes and the different margin categories like inital and variation margin

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACTUS contract type - undefined maturity profile
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow classifier that applies to contracts whose principal may be paid in and out at any point in time without prefixed schedule

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: algorithmic contract category - asymmetric
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow category that applies to combined contracts processed as members of the asymmetric class

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: algorithmic contract category - credit enhancement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow category that applies to basic contracts processed as members of the credit enhancement class

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: algorithmic contract category - fixed income
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow category that applies to basic contracts processed as members of the fixed-income class

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: algorithmic contract category - ownership
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow category that applies to basic contracts processed as members of the ownership class

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: algorithmic contract category - securitization
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow category that applies to combined contracts processed as members of the securitization class

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: algorithmic contract category - symmetric
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cashflow category that applies to combined contracts processed as members of the symmetric class

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: algorithmic contract family - basic
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract family classifier that applies to single (simple) contracts

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: algorithmic contract family - combined
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract family classifier that applies to combined (complex, derived) contracts, such as derivatives

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: algorithmic contract family - credit enhancement
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: contract family classifier that applies to agreements that are related to other agreements or accounts, and provide credit support to existing contracts

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Algorithmic Contract Types classification scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classification scheme behind the ACTUS modeling paradigm, in which standardized Contract Types (CTs) are the granular building blocks of the financial world

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Government of the Kyrgyz Republic
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: unitary parliamentary secular constitutional republic in Central Asia, bordered by Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, and China

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Government of the Republic of Tajikistan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: unitary presidential constitutional secular republic in Central Asia, bordered by Kazakhstan to the north, Kyrgyzstan to the northeast, Tajikistan to the southeast, Afghanistan to the south, Turkmenistan and the autonomous republic of Karakalpakstan to the south-west

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Government of Turkmenistan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: jurisdiction of the Republic of Tajikistan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: jurisdiction of the judiciary of Tajikistan, which is the system of courts that interprets and applies the law in Tajikistan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: jurisdiction of the Republic of Uzbekistan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: jurisdiction of the judiciary of Uzbekistan, which is the system of courts that interprets and applies the law in Uzbekistan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: jurisdiction of Turkmenistan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: jurisdiction of the judiciary of Turkmenistan, which is the system of courts, including the Supreme Court of Turkmenistan and its divisions, that interprets and applies the law in Turkmenistan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sovereign state and polity that is Kazakhstan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: sovereign state and polity that is Uzbekistan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Government of Japan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy with a bicameral legislature in Eastern Asia, bordered on the west by the Sea of Japan, and extending from the Sea of Okhotsk in the north toward the East China Sea and Taiwan in the south

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Government of Mongolia
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: unitary semi-presidential representative democratic republic and landlocked country in Eastern Asia, situated between Russia to the north and China to the south, where it neighbours the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region
