https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Government of the Macao Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: devolved executive-led system within a socialist republic that is a metropolitan area and special administrative region of the People's Republic of China in the western Pearl River Delta by the South China Sea

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Government of the People's Republic of China
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: unitary Marxist-Leninist single-party socialist republic in Eastern Asia, covering approximately 9.6 million square kilometers (3.7 million square miles), that is the world's third or fourth-largest country by area

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Government of the Republic of China

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Government of the Republic of Korea

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: jurisdiction of the judiciary of Hong Kong, which is the system of courts that interprets and applies the law in Hong Kong

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: jurisdiction of Japan
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: jurisdiction of the judiciary of Japan, which is the system of courts, divided into four basic tiers including the Supreme Court and three levels of lower courts, that interprets and applies the law in Japan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: jurisdiction of Macao
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: jurisdiction of the judiciary of Macao, which is the system of courts that interprets and applies the law in Macao

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: jurisdiction of the judiciary of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, which is the system of courts that interpret and apply the law in North Korea

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: accounting period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: qualifier indicating that the relationship period reflects the period of time covered by the most recent validation documents from an accounting perspective for this relationship

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: document filing period
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a qualifier indicating that the relationship period reflects the validity period for any regulatory filing, accounting document, other document demonstrating the relationship's validity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an accounting framework developed by the US Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ISO 17442 code set
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the set of legal entity identifiers that comprise the ISO 17442 legal entity identifier specification

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ISO 20275 code set
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the set of entity legal form identifiers that comprise the ISO 20275 entity legal form specification

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: International Financial Reporting Standard
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an accounting framework developed by the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: other accounting framework
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an accounting framework of unstated origin (other than IFRS or US GAAP)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: relationship status - active
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that as of the last report or update, the reporting legal entity reported that it is legally registered and/or operating, and that the relationship detailed in this relationship record is still valid

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: relationship status - inactive
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that it has been determined that the relationship ended, e.g. because entity that reported this relationship is no longer legally registered and/or operating; or the relationship is no longer valid for other reasons

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ABSORPTION
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions that is a kind of merger where there is a combination of two or more companies into an existing company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ACQUISITION_BRANCH
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions where the acquiring legal entity purchases an international branch entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: BANKRUPTCY
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions in which the status of a legal entity is that it is unable to pay creditors

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: BREAKUP
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions in which a single company splits into two or more independent, separately-run companies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CHANGE_HQ_ADDRESS
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions involving a notification of a change in the headquarters address of the legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CHANGE_LEGAL_ADDRESS
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions involving a notification of a change in the legal address of the legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CHANGE_LEGAL_FORM
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions involving a notification of a change in the legal form of the legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CHANGE_LEGAL_NAME
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions involving a notification of a change in the legal name of the legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CHANGE_OTHER_NAMES
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions involving a notification of a change in the trade- or doing business name of the legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: complex legal form group
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions involving a more complex legal entity event including change of the legal entity status triggered by change of the legal form

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: DEMERGER
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions involving a distribution of securities issued by another legal entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: DISSOLUTION
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions involving (i) A voluntary termination of operations, (ii) a general assignment for the benefit of the legal entity's creditors or (iii) any other liquidation, dissolution or winding up of the legal entity (excluding a Liquidity Event), whether voluntary or involuntary (event completed)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: GLEIF corporate action classification scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheme for classifying corporate actions according to the GLEIF LEI Common Data Format (CDF) schema

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: INSOLVENCY
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions involving the entry of a decree or order by a court or agency or supervisory authority having jurisdiction in the premises the appointment of a trustee-in-bankruptcy or similar official for such party in any insolvency, readjustment of debt, marshalling of assets and liabilities, or similar proceedings, or for the winding up or liquidation of their respective affairs (event completed)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: LIQUIDATION
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions consisting of distribution of cash, assets, or both

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: legal form and name group
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions involving a change in the legal form, name, or other information such as an address change for an organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: MERGERS_AND_ACQUISITIONS
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions in which a single company splits into two or more independent, separately-run companies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: reverse takeover group
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions that are part of a reverse takeover event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: SPINOFF
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions where the shareholders of the original entity are compensated for the value loss of the original entity via shares of the new entity or via dividend

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: standalone group
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions that are single, standalone events rather than a combination of multiple events

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: TRANSFORMATION_BRANCH_TO_SUBSIDIARY
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions involving the transfer of all of the assets and liabilities of an International Branch to the new subsidiary entity in exchange for the transfer of securities representing the capital of the subsidiary entity receiving the transfer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: TRANSFORMATION_SUBSIDIARY_TO_BRANCH
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions involving the transfer of all of the assets and liabilities of a subsidiary to an International Branch entity in exchange for the transfer of securities representing the capital of the International Branch entity receiving the transfer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: TRANSFORMATION_UMBRELLA_TO_STANDALONE
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions involving a notification of a change in the legal form from a Fund legal entity structure with one or more than one sub-funds/compartments to a Fund legal entity structure without sub-funds/compartments

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: VOLUNTARY_ARRANGEMENT
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: GLEIF classifier for corporate actions consisting of a procedure that allows a legal entity to settle debts by paying only a proportion of the amount that it owes to creditors or to come to some other arrangement with its creditors over the payment of its debts (event completed)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: BIDS
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions in which an offer is made to existing shareholders by the issuing company to repurchase equity or other securities convertible into equity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: BONU
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions in which security holders are awarded additional assets free of payment from the issuer in proportion to their holding

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: BPUT
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve early redemption of a security at the election of the holder subject to the terms and condition of the issue with no reduction in nominal value

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CAPD
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that pay shareholders an amount in cash issued from the issuer's capital account

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CAPG
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that distribute profits resulting from the sale of company assets to shareholders

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CHAN
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that disseminate information regarding a change further described in the corporate action details

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CLSA
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions involving a situation where interested parties seek restitution for financial loss

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CONS
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve procedures aiming to obtain consent of holder to a proposal by the issuer or a third party without convening a meeting

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CONV
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve conversion of securities (generally convertible bonds or preferred shares) into another form of securities (usually common shares) at a pre-stated price/ratio

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: DECR
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that reduce the face value of a share or the value of fund assets

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: DFLT
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that indicate a failure by the issuer to perform obligations defined as default events under the bond agreement and that have not been remedied

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: DRIP
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve a dividend payment whereby holders can keep cash or have the cash reinvested into additional shares in the issuing company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: DSCL
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve a requirement for holders or beneficial owners to disclose their name, location and holdings of any issue to the issuer

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: DTCH
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions involving parties wishing to acquire a security

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: DVCA
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that distribute cash to shareholders in proportion to their equity holding

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: DVOP
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve distribution of a dividend to shareholders with a choice of benefit to receive

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: DVSE
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve distribution of a dividend to shareholders in the form of equities of the issuing corporation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: EXOF
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that reflect an exchange of holdings for other securities and/or cash

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: EXRI
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve a call or exercise on nil paid securities or intermediate securities resulting from an intermediate securities distribution (RHDI)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: EXTM
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve prolonging the maturity date of a bond

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: EXWA
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that offer holders the option to buy (call warrant) or to sell (put warrant) a specific amount of stock, cash, or commodity, at a predetermined price, during a predetermined period of time

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: INFO
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions involving information provided by the issuer having no accounting/financial impact on the holder

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: INTR
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve distribution of a regular interest payment to holders of an interest-bearing asset

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ISO 15022 corporate action classification scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: scheme for classifying corporate actions according to ISO 15022 Securities - Scheme for Messages (Data Field Dictionary)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: LIQU
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions consisting of distribution of cash, assets, or both

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: MCAL
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve redemption of an entire issue outstanding of securities prior to maturity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: MRGR
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve the exchange of outstanding securities, initiated by the issuer which may include options, as the result of two or more companies combining assets, that is, an external, third party company

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: PARI
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that occur when securities with different characteristics become identical in all respects

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: PCAL
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve redemption of securities in part before their scheduled final maturity date with reduction of the nominal value of the securities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: PRED
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve redemption of securities in part before their scheduled final maturity date with no reduction in nominal value

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: PRIO
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve a public offer where priority is given to existing shareholders

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: REDM
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve redemption of an entire issue outstanding of securities at final maturity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: REDO
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions by which the unit (currency and/or nominal) of a security is restated

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: RHDI
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions involving the distribution of intermediate securities or privilege that gives the holder the right to take part in a future event

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: SHPR
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that pay shareholders an amount in cash issued from the shares premium reserve

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: SOFF
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve the distribution of subsidiary stock to the shareholders of the parent company without a surrender of shares

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: SPLF
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve an increase in a corporation's number of outstanding equities without any change in the shareholder's equity or the aggregate market value at the time of the split

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: SPLR
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve a decrease in a company's number of outstanding equities without any change in the shareholder's equity or the aggregate market value at the time of the split

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: TEND
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions involving information provided by the issuer having no accounting/financial impact on the holder

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: WRTH
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: ISO 15022 classifier for corporate actions that involve booking out of valueless securities

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unique product identifier reference data library
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: set of data comprised of reference data elements with specific values that together describe the product

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: arithmetic calculation strategy
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: strategy that uses an arithmetic mean calculation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: average rate classification
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Asian option classifier indicating that the payoff is based on the difference between a fixed strike price and the calculated average price of the underlying

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: average strike classification

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: active status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that as of the last report or update, the entity was legally registered and operating

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: annulled status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that the registration was determined to be erroneous or invalid after issuance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: cancelled status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that the registration was abandoned prior to issuance

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: duplicate status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that the registration was determined to be a duplicate registration of the same entity as another registration; duplicate status is assigned to the non-surviving registration (i.e. the identifier that should no longer be used)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity expiration reason - corporate action
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: expiration reason indicating that an entity was acquired or merged with another entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity expiration reason - disolved
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: expiration reason indicating that an entity ceased to operate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity expiration reason - other
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: expiration reason indicating something that is neither due to disolution nor corporate action

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity validation level - entity-supplied only
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Based on the validation procedures in use by the LOU responsible for the record, the information associated with this record has significant reliance on the information that a submitter provided due to the unavailability of corroborating information.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity validation level - fully corroborated
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Based on the validation procedures in use by the LOU responsible for the record, there is sufficient information contained in authoritative public sources to corroborate the information that the submitter has provided for the record.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: entity validation level - partially corroborated
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Based on the validation procedures in use by the LOU responsible for the record, the information supplied by the registrant can be partially corroborated by public authoritative sources, while some of the record is dependent upon the information that the registrant submitted, either due to conflicts with authoritative information, or due to data unavailability.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: inactive status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that the entity is no longer legally registered and/or operating, whether as a result of business closure, acquisition by or merger with another (or new) entity, or determination of illegitimacy

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: issued status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that the registration has been validated and issued, and which identifies an entity that was operating legally as of the last update

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: lapsed status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that the registration that has not been renewed by the specified renewal date and is not known by public sources to have ceased operation as of the last update

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: merged status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that the registration is for an entity that has been merged into another legal entity, such that this legal entity no longer exists as an independently operating entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pending archival status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that the registration is about to be transferred to a different registration authority, after which its registration status will revert to a non-pending status

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pending transfer status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that the registration has requested transfer to a different registration authority, and for which transfer is in progress

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pending validation status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that an application for registration has been submitted and is in process, pending validation

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: retired status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that the registration is for an entity that has ceased operation, without having been merged into another entity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: transferred status
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: status indicating that the registration that has been transferred to a different registration authority

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: open trade

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: terminated trade

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business day following
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention specifying that a non-business date will be adjusted to the first following day that is a business day

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business day modified following
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention specifying that a non-business date will be adjusted to the first following day that is a business day unless that day falls in the next calendar month, in which case that date will be the first preceding day that is a calendar date

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business day modified preceding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention specifying that a non-business date will be adjusted to the first preceding day that is a business day unless that day falls in the previous month, in which case that date will be the first following day that is a business day

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business day nearest
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention specifying that a non-business date will be adjusted to the nearest day that is a business day -- i.e. if the non-business day falls on any day other than a Sunday or a Monday, it will be the first preceding day that is a business day, and will be the first following business day if it falls on a Sunday or a Monday

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business day none
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention specifying that a date will not be adjusted if it falls on a day that is not a business day

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: business day preceding
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: convention specifying that a date will be adjusted to the first previous day that is a business day

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: calendar month
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: time interval resulting from the division of a calendar year in 12 time intervals, each with a specific name and containing a specific number of calendar days

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: calendar quarter
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: time interval of 3 months, starting on January 1, April 1, July 1, or October 1

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: calendar week
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: time interval of seven calendar days starting on a Monday

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: calendar year
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: cyclic time interval in a calendar which is required for one revolution of the Earth around the Sun and approximated to an integral number of calendar days; a year in the Gregorian calendar

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Friday
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: time interval that has duration 1 day and that meets a Saturday

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: from the end
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: time direction indicating that a calendar-specified date is the nth date from the end of a calendar period

annotations.example: Two days before the end of a calendar month.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: from the start
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: time direction indicating that a calendar-specified date is the nth day from the beginning of a calendar period.

annotations.example: The first day of a calendar quarter. (The offsetDay is zero.)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: pier

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rear
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: side or part of a building at the back, located opposite its front

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: room
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: partitioned part of the inside of a building

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: side
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: place, space, or direction with respect to a center or to a line of division

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: insufficient collateral value
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The application was denied because the value or type of collateral was not sufficient.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: insufficient credit history

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: insufficient income

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mortgage insurance denied
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The application was denied because necessary mortgage insurance was denied.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: unverifiable information
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The application was denied because qualification information such as income, employment, credit, or residence) was not verifiable.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: manual underwriting
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: underwriting was performed manually

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fee-simple ownership interest

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fractional ownership interest

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: subordinate lien position

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: American Express network

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Discover network

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: JCB network

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Mastercard network

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Visa network

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: manufactured

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: mobile home
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a dwelling unit constructed on a base frame which features wheels and axles to be used in transporting home from place to place

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: modular
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a factory-built dwelling not on a permanent chassis

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: on frame modular
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a factory built dwelling on a permanent chassis which does not have a HUD label

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: site built
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: describes construction process, indicating that most elements are created at the homes permanent site. May include some prefabricated components

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: adjustable rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a loan that allows the lender to periodically adjust the interest rate in accordance with a specified index

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: fixed rate
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a loan in which the interest rate and payments remain the same for the life of the loan

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: graduated payment
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a flexible payment loan where the payments increase for a specified period of time and then level off

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: graduated payment adjustable
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a loan for which there are periodic payments/rate changes with additional specified principal and interest changes as documented in the Security Instruments.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: growing equity

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: rate improvement

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: step
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a loan with fixed periodic payment/rate changes without subsidy or negative amortization.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an automated underwriting software system used by the USDA rural development loan program

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Loan Prospector
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: an automated underwriting software system produced by Freddie Mac

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a cashout mortgage where the amount is limited by the lenger. 80% loan to value ratio is a common limit.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: no cashout
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: The mortgage is refinanced for less than or equal to what is owed.

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a charge for an appraisal

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: discount points

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: a charge for an origination

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: the principal of the loan that is owed

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: 5 or more units

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: common equity tier 1

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: EU Regulation 236/2012

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: tier 2 capital

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Regulation S

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Rule 144A

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: SEC Exemption 3(c)(7)
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: securities regulation that is a provision under the Investment Company Act of 1940 that allows certain privately offered funds to operate without registering with the SEC

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: SEC Rule 201
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: securities regulation that is part of Regulation SHO that is a circuit breaker limiting short sales to prevent them from causing a security's price to drop further after a significant decline

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: TEFRA C rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: securities regulation that is a U.S. Treasury Regulation section 1.163-5(c)(2)(i)(C), or any successor regulation, established under the Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act of 1982 (TEFRA), that relates to the classification of debt obligations as either 'bearer' or 'registered' for U.S. tax purposes and ensures that an issue of bearer debt satisfied 'reasonable arrangement' requirements

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: TEFRA D rule
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: securities regulation that is a U.S. Treasury Regulation section 1.163-5(c)(2)(i)(D), or any successor regulation, established under the Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act of 1982 (TEFRA), that relates to the classification of debt obligations as either 'bearer' or 'registered' for U.S. tax purposes, applies to most straightforward issues of bearer debt in the Euromarkets, and ensures that an issue of bearer debt satisfied 'reasonable arrangement' requirements

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Global Industry Classification Standards scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classification scheme that is a hierarchical four-level system classifying companies based on the principal business activity of the organization

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: ISO 10962 2019-10 code set
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: Fourth Edition, 2019-10 version of the ISO 10962 Classification of Financial Instruments (CFI) Code scheme

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Industry Classification Benchmark scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: classification scheme that is a hierarchical four-level system classifying companies based on their main source of revenue

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CGS CUSIP Access Repository
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: CGS (CUSIP Global Services) CUSIP Access services and repository, a proprietary repository of security identifiers, issued by CUSIP Global Services, that is the National Securities Identifying Number (NSIN) for securities issued in North America, which is also part of the ISIN for the security it identifies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CUSIP Global Services
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: CUSIP Global Services financial services provider that is the national numbering agency (NNA) for CUSIPs in North America

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: CUSIP International Numbering System (CINS) scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: security identification scheme that extends the CUSIP scheme, used to identify securities outside of the United States and Canada for the purposes of facilitating clearing and settlement of trades

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP) scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: national security identification scheme used to identify all North American stocks and registered bonds for the purposes of facilitating clearing and settlement of trades

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: common code repository
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: distributed international repository of security identifiers, issued by Euroclear or Clearstream (CEDEL), that are used to identify securities in Europe for the purposes of facilitating clearing and settlement of trades

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Euroclear Clearstream common code scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: nine-digit security identification scheme, defined originally by Euroclear and CEDEL (now Clearstream) that is used to identify securities in Europe for the purposes of facilitating clearing and settlement of trades

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI) Registry
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: open, OMG standards-based registry used by the FIGI registration authority to manage the financial instrument identifiers and related information that it registers according to the Financial Instrument Global Identifier (FIGI) standard

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: financial instrument global identifier scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: standard identification scheme for financial instrument identifiers (not limited to securities) and, in some cases, related listings, published by the Object Management Group (OMG)

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Financial Times interactive data scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: proprietary identification scheme for securities identifiers managed by the Financial Times

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Refinitiv instrument code scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: proprietary identification scheme for securities identifiers managed by the London Stock Exchange Group's LSEG Financial Solutions

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: SEDOL Master File
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: repository of security identifiers, issued by the London Stock Exchange, that is the National Securities Identifying Number (NSIN) for securities issued in the United Kingdom, which is also part of the ISIN for the security it identifies

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Stock Exchange Daily Official List (SEDOL) scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: national security identification scheme used to identify all stocks and registered bonds in the United Kingdom for the purposes of facilitating clearing and settlement of trades

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Telekurs security identifier scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: proprietary identification scheme for securities identifiers formerly managed by SIX Telekurs Ltd, a subsidiary of the SIX Group (Swiss Infrastructure and eXchange), now SIX Financial Information AG

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: Valoren scheme
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: national security identification scheme used to identify equity and debt securities in Switzerland, Liechtenstein and Belgium for the purposes of facilitating clearing and settlement of trades

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bearer and registered form
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: form of a security that may be issued in both bearer and registered form but with the same identification number

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: bearer form
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: form of a security that is not registered in the books of the issuer or of the registrar and is payable to the person possessing the stock or bond certificate

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: book entry form
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: form of a security in which ownership is recorded electronically by a central depository

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: miscellaneous form
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: form of a security that is not categorized

https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.label: registered form
https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontolog.definition: form of a security whereby ownership is recorded in the name of the owner on the books of the issuer or the issuer's registrar and can only be transferred to another owner when endorsed by the registered owner
